Title: Mange hensyn blev taget til Bornholm - rederierne venter 27.000 årsværk: Kæmpe vindmøller til energi-ø skal stå 20 km fra Bornholm
Content:
Then it is firm where the huge offshore wind turbines, which become the starting point for Bornholm as an energy island, will be located: 20 kilometers south and south-west of the island.

The location is decided by the parties behind the Folketing's climate agreement. At the same time, they have decided to start investigating a large area in the North Sea, where no later than next spring is located for several offshore wind farms and another energy island. It will be at least 60 kilometers west of Thorsminde, it is clear to a start.

"At the energy island of Bornholm, the wind turbines are placed about 20 kilometers south and southwest of the rocky island. In the North Sea the parties have agreed to start preparations for the feasibility studies for the energy island and the offshore wind turbines," states a press release from the climate, energy, energy and the Ministry of Supply.

The two energy islands will together be able to triple Danish power production from offshore wind turbines and supply about five million households in Denmark and our neighboring countries with green electricity. The production of five gigawatts will be about three times as much energy as the Danish offshore wind turbines together produce today.

- We are now entering a new era in the Danish wind adventure, and I would like to thank the other parties in the agreement for good cooperation around the location of the world's two first energy islands. The energy islands will help to significantly increase the amount of renewable energy, and at the same time we will allow the green power to be transformed into fuels into the heavy transport both on land, at sea and in the air. In other words, the energy islands deliver the green stream, which is the prerequisite for the climate -neutral Denmark and Europe of the future, says climate minister Dan Jørgensen (S).

R: Great consideration for Bornholm As one of the parties behind the agreement, Radicals report that considerations of both the Bornholm population and nature have been thought of when it was decided where the wind turbines should be.

- I am glad that we have now decided on where the world's first energy island should be. This is another step in the right climate and absolutely necessary for us to reach the goal of our great visions in 2030. It has been important to me that the decision has taken into account the locals and nature at Bornholm, says climate rapporteur Ruben Kidde (R).

The Ministry of Climate calls the two energy islands "the beginning of a whole new era in the expansion of offshore wind, (there) will cement Denmark's position as the world's leading nation in green energy". Dan Jørgensen is also not the only enthusiastic politician.

- Energy islands are a fantastic future project and is the next level of the Danish wind adventure.

It will require innovation that can form the basis for new export adventures. And then it is a huge gain for the climate because we can supply even more green power with the energy islands that can be used -not only in the electrical outlets, but also for fuel, says climate spokesman Tommy Ahlers (V).

- Denmark is now taking a step more towards the fossil -free society. With the wind energy that the two energy islands produce, we create the basis for future energy production and the development of the power-to-X solutions that are the prerequisite for the green transformation, says energy and supply mayor Egil Fabritius Hulgaard (K).

At the same time, the Ministry of Climate states that many factors have played into where the wind turbines are placed.

"The locations of offshore winds at Bornholm and the gross area of ​​the energy island in the North Sea are chosen based on a thorough assessment of the most optimal production conditions based on, among other things, wind resources and sea depths as well as ship routes, existing infrastructure, fishing and environmental conditions," states the ministry's press release.


27,000 man -years on the way

The upcoming energy island will create many jobs. It all agrees, but now Danish shipping companies also offer how many.

- It is good news that the Bornholmers are now of certainty about where their new energy island should be. According to our latest report, the Energy Island will secure approximately 27,000 full-time years related to the expansion of offshore wind on the island, and a large part of the man-years will of course accrue to Bornholm, says Jacob K. Clasen, Deputy CEO of Danish Shipowners.

- The expansion of offshore wind gives a boost to the green transition, but also a push for continued Danish growth and employment. Not only on Bornholm, but throughout the country, he adds.

It has been important to me that the decision has taken into account the local population and nature at Bornholm Ruben Kidde (R) climate mayor.

Title: Alle har en rolle i, at vi bliver klar

There, Business Center Bornholm has an important role as a partner and birth assistant.

Therefore, it is important that the Business Center Bornholm constantly has an understanding of the companies' challenges and wishes, and that the Business Center Bornholm together with the companies defines future development initiatives.

I think we can have a huge advantage in that we are a relatively small community. We know each other and can lift in bunch.

Karen Bladt, Chairman of the Board of Business Center Bornholm.

Title: Det kan få større betydning for Bornholm, end fiskeriet havde
Content:
27,000 full -time equivalents. An energy island and an offshore wind farm of the size proposed erected off Bornholm will throw a lot of jobs off their lifetime of 20 years. If Bornholm can get just a few percent of those jobs, it will have a huge effect, states Rønne Harbor CEO Thomas Bendtsen.

During the process of first making Rønne Harbor a shipping port and then in extension of making Bornholm a Bornholm, as the government has suggested in a climate action in May this year, a lot more or less wild figures have been presented for, what it will mean for employment. Some gently refrain from predicting that kind of thing, such as Mayor Winni Grosbøll does it elsewhere in this magazine. Thomas Bendtsen is not one of them.

- I have referred to a report this summer that showed that every time you invest in 1 GW of offshore wind turbine energy, 14,600 man -years are secured in the offshore wind farm. If you put the energy island on top, it will require 27,000 man -years throughout the park's lifetime. What you can ask about is how much of what will accrue to Bornholm? I do not believe that there will be 27,000 jobs at Bornholm, Rønne Harbor CEO admits.

But then he still raises the bar for a bit by including the "energy -wise", as the German Chancellor Angela Merkel's plan for a green transition for all of Germany is called.

- If it is to be implemented, we are talking about 90 GW. It will give a huge employment effect throughout the region. And if we can get just a few percent of those jobs, it can be more important to Bornholm than fishing had.

Living up to all requirements for five years, Rønne Harbor has worked strategically to show that the port has its justification in relation to the offshore wind market.

- DKK 600 million has been invested. DKK in expanding the port. It is always a gossip. But then it is also designed to live up to the demands that the market requires. The offshore components are incredibly large and heavy. If you put a turbine from an offshore wind turbine down on the old cruise, it would go straight through.

Therefore, the entire area of ​​the new harbor has a high carrying capacity and is designed for the various turbine manufacturers.

To illustrate what it is about, explains the CEO the dimensions behind: - A turbine can weigh 400 tons. If you imagine a vertical spun wall where you put a heavy crane very close to the edge and at the same time have a turbine ship that puts your feet down right outside, it creates a torque against the spun wall, which is huge.

The demands must be fulfilled by Rønne Harbor, just as there are a number of other guidelines that must be followed if you want to cooperate with the offshore wind industry.

- There are many quality assurance and security requirements, but it is completely in line with all other serious companies. We have been out early and finding out what requirements were. For example, all communication is in English, so already in 2014 we sent the first team of employees to English teaching every Friday, says Thomas Bendtsen, summarizing: - There are no requirements we cannot live up to. But we have also worked with it.

I miss vision since the Offshore Center Bornholm was founded in late 2014 Rønne Harbor has generally experienced great support from the Bornholm business community. They have supported the visions that Rønne Harbor had to draw a new business to the island, and the participating companies themselves have been looking for the opportunities that were for them.

- That is why it is also a great pleasure for me when they now say that this is not so bad at all, says Thomas Bendtsen.

- We notice increasing support among all the business organizations, and they are working to get the education and position themselves properly. The biggest work right now is in quality assurance, and there are some Bornholm companies that have taken up. At the same time, the support from the political team has been rapidly increasing, well helped along the way by the ambitious goal the government has set for the energy island. A lot of money has been invested in future -proofing business - and it is clear that when the orders and projects start rolling in, we also feel a growing interest.

How clear would you like to consider that the Bornholm companies have been? - There are some companies that have prepared for the wind adventure.

They have done well. But there is a tendency for you to like development, but just not if it causes change. There I could miss a little more vision and an understanding that we are acting in an international market at Rønne Harbor. But the companies that have positioned themselves from the small craftsmen to larger companies they have also delivered.

The first step in the adventure right now Rønne Harbor is preparing for in the coming weeks to receive the first components of the offshore wind turbines on Kriegers Flak and then MHI Vestas' project in 2022. But of course it is not done with that.

- We need to get more projects for Bornholm and make Bornholm visible as Energiø to our stakeholders. The next element we need to bring is Power-to-X, where we have to convert the power into fuel. This is only the first small step in an adventure that will last for the next 20-25 years, promises Thomas Bendtsen.

And adds that when the offshore wind turbines are worn out after that time, there is also a job of peeling them down again, which at that time can get jobs for a Bornholm that will look completely different from what we know today .

It will give a huge employment effect throughout the region. And if we can get just a few percent of those jobs, it can be more important to Bornholm than fishing had.

Thomas Bendtsen, CEO of Rønne Harbor.

Title: Flere ben at stå på
Content:
The energy island can become a new leg for the Bornholm business community. Søren Møller Christensen and Louise Groth-Michelsen will for Bornholm Region Municipality up to and including 2022 coordinate the efforts between the regional municipality, business, business promotion players and educational institutions, so that Bornholm does not end up selling rolls for a workforce that comes from outside.

The very big Bornholm efforts in the past decade, the National Assembly and the Bright Green Island, were both characterized by the whole island being engaged in them, companies, public institutions, associations and private. The energy island is, at least in the initial process, primarily a project for the Bornholm business community.

- But just as tourism means a lot to many, this could mean a lot to the Bornholmers, says Louise Groth-Michelsen, who has just started in the role of coordinating energy worker in Bornholm's regional municipality.

- It can be a new leg for the Bornholm business community.

We don't have so many legs and you can see how hard it hit with the corona crisis. We can get a wider commercial landscape, elaborates Søren Møller Christensen, who is the leader of the coordinating energy co -operation, which is in the process of uncovering needs and potentials in connection with the energy island.


Total effect

For although both Bright Green Island and the National Assembly - the latter Louise Groth -Michelsen in her time helped to start - also aimed to create new forms of employment on Bornholm, the aim is thus even more business -oriented when it comes to working with the energy island , explains Søren Møller Christensen.

- The reason we want the energy island is that it can give the island a business effect on a large scale, and it will add some activities we have not tried before on Bornholm.

This is exactly what means it is so important that the processing is done thoroughly, he explains further: - If we were to build a thousand new houses, business at Bornholm would know how to do it. We just had to scale up.

But now wind turbines have to be built. And when we stand with something that is so new, there is not one actor who can only lift the task.

That is why Bornholm Regional Municipality, Campus Bornholm, Business Center Bornholm, Bornholm Energi & Forsyning, Offshore Center Bornholm and the entire business community must work together to translate the energy island into Bornholm jobs and green transition at Bornholm, he emphasizes.

- We know from other places and other contexts that if we are to seize this, we have to act together. But then it will also have a collective impact, ie a common effect. Everyone can see that this will be good for Bornholm. It must be the common goal that controls us - but with room for each one to pursue their own sub -goals.

- The common effect, for example, we saw when we started the People's Meeting.

Bornholm stood together on a common goal and implemented.

The people around the island to secure transport, beds, permits, safety, parking spaces, food and toilets in a short time got it all clapping, from the final decision had been made to hold the National Assembly, not much more than one went Half a year before Bornholm had mobilized and was ready to welcome the first People's Meeting guests. This interaction is Bornholm companies and organizations just super good at, adds Louise Groth-Michelsen.

Out of the silos it is to ensure that the individual goals of the participants lead to the common goal that a coordinating function is linked to the energy island project.

- We need to make sure there is a red thread in the work so that it does not run in silos. There must be an experience collection from the current project with the offshore wind turbines, which we can use in the energy island project.

And then the coordinating energy worker has to work with the long -term strategy. The coordinating employee must ensure that we get the strategic papers prepared that the various actors can implement, explains Christa Lodahl, business manager at Business Center Bornholm.

- There has to be a coordinating function in a project like this, Søren Møller Christensen gives her right.

- You get no effect by the fact that many just sit down.

Louise's role is to help all of us partners clarify the common goal and to get it measured on the way so we can see what works and what doesn't work so we can all become wiser along the way we Now starts.

More than rolls Therefore, Søren Møller Christensen and Louise Groth-Michelsen together with the group of actors in the coordinating collaboration are in the process of defining the goals they will work for in the coming time.

- We need to build up a lobbying organization and we need to find out how we are rusting the companies to offer the tasks that are coming. We need to find out how we get upgraded labor and how we can attract labor. We need to find out if we can attract some companies of a type we don't have on the island now. Over the autumn and winter, we must concretize these tasks and find out how to best get them here, summarizes Søren Møller Christensen.

Because although Bornholm has been designated as Energiø, the island may still risk missing out the possibilities.

- The horror scenario is that most of the workplaces go to people who do not live on Bornholm, he emphasizes and adds: - We can risk that we are primarily going to sell rolls and beds to people who come to travelers.

- It will be really exciting to help implement the potential that is being unfolded now, ends a hopeful Louise Groth-Michelsen.

We need to avoid being primarily selling rolls and beds to people who come travelers here.

Søren Møller Christensen, Head of Development and Plan in Bornholm Region Municipality.


A joint effort

Bornholm Regional Municipality, Rønne Harbor, Campus Bornholm, Offshore Center Bornholm, Bornholm Energi & Forsyning and Business Center Bornholm have decided that they will work together that Energiø Bornholm and the upcoming offshore tasks at Rønne Harbor will result in Bornholm workplaces and green transition at Bornholm. In order to support the work, Bornholm Regional Municipality has chosen to finance an employee who in 2021 and 2022 must coordinate and support the joint work.

Collective Impact The six parties who collaborate on Energiø and Offshore Tasks - Bornholm Regional Municipality, Rønne Harbor, Campus Bornholm, Offshore Center Bornholm, Bornholm Energi & Forsyning and Business Center Bornholm - is inspired by a method called Collective Impact. The method is originally from the United States, but has been used in lack of countries in connection with complex projects that can only succeed when many work together because no one has neither enough resources nor all the relevant skills. It is about playing each other good and about lifting in a bunch with an eye for a common desire for a greater societal change, explains Søren Møller Christensen.

Collective Impact focuses on five efforts to be pursued if you want to succeed: 1. Common Agenda and Concrete Goals 2. is that the six parties succeed with the five efforts. The first task is to define the common agenda and set up specific goals that they can jointly pursue.

    The energy island will be able to mean a lot to many Bornholmers, says Louise Groth-Michelsen. Photo: Jacob Jepsen.

Title: Brug kræfterne fornuftigt
Content:
When the large Gigawatt wind farms are put into operation, they will at times produce more energy than can be taken from customers. The excess energy can be used at power-to-X stations, where it among other things. a. can create synthetic fuel. How it goes to and why it is important to get it to Bornholm, explains project manager Torben Jørgensen from Bornholm Energi & Forsyning A/ S.

When the wind blows strongly, the wind farms in the Baltic Sea will produce extra power. Also more than can be taken from customers. Then there are two things to do: One is to stop some of the wind turbines temporarily while it is blowing violently. The other, in which there are far greater perspectives, is to use the excess power for something sensible.

This is the last thing Torben Jørgensen hopes for. And as project manager at Bornholm Energi & Forsyning A/ S's development department, he hopes that it will be possible here at Bornholm as part of the energy island.

- It considers the planners with us realistic. There are some huge amounts of energy that come into the system when it is blowing, so the offshore wind farms need to have large decrease options.

We need to be able to take the peak of power production, also because it will mean that smaller and cheaper cables can be laid on the seabed from Bornholm and on to the outside world, he explains.

It is primarily in the autumn and the winter months that will be produced an excess of wind energy, but it can be complemented by the upcoming solar parks that will be able to produce large amounts of electricity in the summer months.

Coherence between Energiø and offshore wind turbines It requires the cables from the offshore wind farms to be collected on Bornholm, which is why it is so important that the work is done for the energy island now, Torben Jørgensen emphasizes.

- But fortunately Bornholm Regional Municipality and Rønne Harbor have also actively gone into the work to make sure they do not just drum past us. We would like to see them not put it all in Copenhagen.

This is one of the places where the project with the energy island coincides directly with the large offshore wind turbine project, which is currently underway at Rønne Harbor. A project that would like to get more in the Baltic Sea if it is to have a really big effect.

It is important that Bornholm early in the process has an influence on the location of the power-to-X stations, as they can be placed on platforms outside the wind turbines, on Bornholm, or at Copenhagen, where the cables come in.

The Power-to-X stations need to use the excess power to create synthetic fuel. It is, popularly, what is the x in the equation. It happens by electrolysis as the first step where water is split into hydrogen and oxygen, explains Torben Jørgensen Pedagogically: - Commercially Electrolysis has been used since the early 1900s, where, for example, in Norway used hydropower to produce nitrogen fertilizer to agriculture. In fact, it is also a kind of fuel: you are developing engines for ships that can use ammonia as fuel.

The idea of ​​Power-to-X stations on Bornholm is in the first step to produce hydrogen, which in itself can be used as fuel for buses and trucks as well as for process energy in the industry. Private cars can also run on hydrogen, but here is primarily expected to electrically as the fuel of the future.

- But it is suitable for heavy transport. In trucks and buses it doesn't make sense to have such large batteries as it takes now to drive them on electricity, so it makes better sense to let them run on hydrogen or other synthetic fuels from Power-to-X instead.

Against a fossil -free Bornholm, however, it is not only the transport sector that will benefit from hydrogen and synthetic fuels, explains Torben Jørgensen.

In industry and business, most Bornholm companies have gradually changed to use gas instead of oil when energy and heat is needed for work processes. Whether it is machine workshops, breweries or food companies.

- Most people today use LPG, or Liquified Petroleum Gas: This is what you buy in glass bottles, but many Bornholm companies have established larger or smaller tanks, which are then filled by tankers. It has the immediate advantage that CO2 emissions are far less than if you used oil.

But in fact, CO2 can also be used in the power-to-X process, says Torben Jørgensen.

- It is experimented with using CO2 from incinerators where you can pull it out of the combustion air.

So it may well be that electrolysis as a commercial technology has been running for a hundred years, but the technology where you associate hydrogen with CO2 in that way is new. We can also pull CO2 out of the air and use it.

Bornholms Energi & Forsyning A/ S has previously, together with Bornholm Region Municipality, been involved in an EU application to get support for an electrolysis plant., Without luck in the first place. But if the energy island becomes a reality, then the possibility of succeeding is much greater, Torben Jørgensen estimates.

The perspective is clear: - We can make ourselves fossil -free with this.

And that is a reasonable goal of applying the forces.

We can make ourselves fossil -free with this.

Torben Jørgensen, project manager at Bornholm Energi & Forsyning A/ S.

    Power-to-X stations will be able to convert excess energy from the offshore wind turbines to hydrogen, which can be used in the transport sector.

Title: Energinet og tysk modpart skal have den store regnemaskine i brug: Ny aftale med Tyskland er helt essentiel for bornholmsk energiø
Content:
"A Danish-German breakthrough for Energiø Bornholm".

This is how Energinet denotes the agreement that the Danish system operator has entered into with German 50Hertz. It is the first agreement made between Denmark and another country regarding the Energy Islands in the Baltic Sea and the North Sea.

By the end of the year, the two parties must investigate whether it is advantageous to build a cable connection between Zealand and Northeast Germany via Bornholm.

The agreement with the Germans is the first that the Danish authorities have concluded, and thus the Energiø project is moving from being based on Danish and international political agreements to a concrete, cross-border cooperation between two countries' system operators (typically referred to as TSOs).

- The whole essence of these energy islands is that they must be connected to other countries.

The energy island itself without foreign connections is not a project, says Hanne Storm Edlefsen from Energinet's Department of Strategic Planning to Bornholm Tidende.

- It is the foreign connections that, in combination with the collection points close to the place where the electricity is produced, is the brilliant. Therefore, it is crucial that others want to help count on these things and can see the potential, she elaborates.

In Germany, it is Energinet's experience that both the German government and the system operators warmly support both Danish energy island projects.


Where the power is flowing

The upcoming analyzes will be used to assess whether it is worthwhile to make a connection between the countries. Based on the fact that the offshore wind turbines at the Bornholm Energi island get a capacity of two gigawatts, the two TSOs will perform some very advanced calculations.

- We have some big market models - such big calculators - that we put a lot of data in. And then we count on different scenarios and see where the power is flowing, where there is marketing and what it means for the finances of the connections.

Pictured, it is to see if black or red numbers are coming out of the calculations, explains Hanne Storm Edlefsen, Vice President of Strategic Planning.

- I have, the hand on the heart, no sense of where we land. So it will actually be really exciting to make these calculations with our German colleagues.

The studies will also be on what improvements are needed with the connection in Zealand and on the German coast, so that the new cables can be linked to the existing network.

- It doesn't have much to say compared to Bornholm. We have to count on whether some grid reinforcements should be made locally where the connections go ashore, says Hanne Storm Edlefsen.

Exactly where the cables may need to be carried ashore, at Energinet and 50Hertz not yet.

The analyzes initially take good handfuls of different scenarios, which will be narrowed in later in the year.

- On the other side of the summer holidays, in early autumn, we expect to have the results.

Then we can move on with the two or three scenarios that fall out best. And then it will be those who are planned for political decision, explains Hanne Storm Edlefsen about the process.


More placements in games at Bornholm

In November, Energy Minister Dan Jørgensen Energinet ordered the preliminary investigations of the Energy Islands. Energinet is preparing for a tender. As part of the feasibility studies, Energinet is looking at where the cables from the offshore wind farm can be carried ashore, and where on Bornholm land a land plant can be located. One of the candidates is a location in connection with Energinet's submarine cable plant, located at the Tofte cottage area south of Hasle.

- There are a few options that we look at - among other things at our existing station. It is an obvious opportunity that we will clearly look at first if it looks reasonable, says Hanne Storm Edlefsen.

The land facility on Bornholm will be a central hub for the collection, transformation and forwarding of electricity from the offshore wind farms, where the nearest mills will be 20 kilometers from the south coast, to Zealand and probably Germany.

The whole essence of these energy islands is that they must be connected to other countries. The energy island itself without foreign connections is not a project.

Hanne Storm Edlefsen Energinets Department of Strategic Planning.

Title: Siemens Gamesas projektleder tog Bornholms Tidende med ind på arealet, som vindmølleproducenten har lejet af Rønne Havn: Intet overlades til tilfældigheder på sitet
Content:
Det er tirsdag, og jack up-skibet Vole au Vent er tilbage i Rønne efter mølle nummer fem, seks, syv og otte til danmarkshistoriens største havvindmøllepark.

Vi ruller mod havneporten, dagen efter den første mølle på Kriegers Flak har produceret strøm. Installationsskibet anløb Rønne Havn klokken 3 i nat, så anden lastning har været i gang i en halv snes timer, da vi parkerer redaktionsbilen.

Indtil denne dag har vi som mange andre rønneboer fulgt projektet på behørig afstand fra lysningen på Galløkken, men nu har vi fået lov til at komme indenfor. Siemens Gamesa ønskede at sikre sig, at der var styr på alle procedurerne, inden de tog imod gæster fra pressen.

Det har også krævet lidt praktisk forberedelse at få adgang til " sitet", som havnearealet kaldes med professionel havnelingo. For at blive lukket ind skal man stille med en negativ covid-test, og vi har en dugfrisk erklæring på, at vi er negative, med i inderlommen.

Portvagten, bornholmske Per Safft, tjekker corona-dokumentet og rækker os nogle papirer, som vi skal udfylde og underskrive.

En anden obligatorisk sikkerhedsforanstaltning er en temperaturmåling.

Hver morgen får alle taget temperaturen, før de kan træde ind på arbejdspladsen. Frem finder Per en skanner, som han først retter mod min pande og dernæst fotografens. To hurtige bip betyder, at vores hoveder ikke er mistænkeligt overophedede. Kort efter dukker Bent Rasmussen, Siemens Gamesas projektleder på Kriegers Flak-parken, op. Portvagten meddeler, at kysten er klar, og gæsternes temperatur er taget.

- Fik de taget den med kviksølvtermometer bagi? spørger projektlederen, inden vi hilser på hinanden med et albuestød.


LOGISTISK HOVEDBRUD

Han er temmelig træt af corona. Et gennemplanlagt anlægsprojekt af denne kaliber harmonerer dårligt med alle pandemiens usikkerheder.

Svigter en underleverandør gennem længere tid, vil det skabe millionforsinkelser.

Forhindres mandskabet i at nå frem, vil det også være højst problematisk.

Logistikken skulle gentænkes, da de svenske myndigheder lukkede transitkorridoren.

- Vi skulle aldrig have tabt Skåne, Halland og Blekinge, siger Bent Rasmussen, efter vi er trådt ind i containerhovedkvarterets forrum.

Flere underleverandører er involveret i arbejdet. Der er kranoperatøren, tårnmontøren og Deutsche Windtechnik, som fører tilsyn på vegne af bygherren, energiselskabet Vattenfall, mens Rønne-virksomheden BHS Logistics er hyret til at assistere med losningen af vindmøllekomponenter.

- Det lyder smart, og det var det, indtil covid kom. Så var det dælme ikke smart længere, konstaterer Bent Rasmussen om de mange sammenbragte medarbejdere og virksomheder.

Alle disse forsamlede mennesker, hvoraf en del er udenlandske specialister, er nødt til at leve disciplineret under projektet på grund af smitterisikoen. Siemens Gamesas folk sover på hoteller i Rønne, og det forventes, at de ikke løber nogen risici.

- De har fået et informationsbrev med retningslinjer. Som Angela Merkel siger: " Det er ufatteligt så langt, man kan nå med sund fornuft".

Indtil nu er det lykkedes at holde coronavirussen ude af pladsen på Rønne Havn.

Arbejderne er organiseret i mindre grupper, så et eventuelt smittetilfælde vil blive isoleret til færrest mulig, og hver torsdag kommer Falck og tester alle, der har deres gang på pladsen.

Særligt kritisk er det at undgå, at virussen finder vej til installationsskibet, fortæller projektlederen.

- Det er installationsskibet, alting drejer omkring. Hvis det ligger stille, begynder der at ligge for mange komponenter i Rønne.


PARK-GRUS-PARK

Bent Rasmussen har på forhånd stillet et par sikkerhedssko frem, som jeg kan låne. Vi får også udleveret sikkerhedsbriller og skifter vores medbragte gule veste ud med orange, så det er tydeligt, at vi er gæster. Hjelme har vi selv sørget for. Ud over projektlederen skal sitets sikkerhedsansvarlige, Leif Clausen, akkompagnere os rundt på pladsen. Sådan er reglerne, når gæsterne ikke har gennemført et sikkerhedskursus.

Inden vi går ud i kulden, viser vores vært os et kort over vindmølleparken. Den udmærker sig ved at være todelt. I midten ligger et statsligt råstofudvindingsområde, der leverer grus til et af årtiets andre store infrastrukturprojekter, Femern-forbindelsen.

Den østligste del af parken kliner sig op ad det sted, hvor svensk, dansk og tysk territorium grænser op til hinanden. " Flak" betyder rev på begrænset dybde - i dette tilfælde er den 20-30 meter - og den højtbeliggende havbund egner sig til havvindsprojekter.

Tyskland kom skandinaverne i forkøbet og opførte parken Baltic II i 2015, hvis 80 møller har en kapacitet på 288 megawatt. Siden da har havvindmølleteknologien udviklet sig, og Kriegers Flaks 72 møller kan yde 604 megawatt.

Det kan dække strømforbruget i 600.000 husstande, eller omtrent hele København, forklarer Bent Rasmussen.

Der er trukket kabler mellem den danske og tyske park.

- Det er ret unikt. Hvis tyskerne har for meget strøm, kan de sende det op til os via hovedtransformatorstationen, fortæller Bent Rasmussen.

- Det var sjovt nok også det her installationsskib, der lavede Baltic II, bemærker han.

Vi forlader skurvognen og sætter kurs mod Vole au Vent, hvor de første fire vinger er blevet lastet. Vingespidserne stritter ud over vandsiden af riggen. Skibets dæk er hævet nogle få meter over havnebassinet ved hjælp af de fire ben, der er " jacket op".

Sikkerhedsmanden opfordrer os til at gå forsigtigt, for der er glat. Da jeg nær falder bagover på isen, minder han mig om, at man skal holde sig på det skridsikre sand, der er lagt som et fortov rundt på arealet. På det 15 hektar store areal er tårnelementer, vinger og naceller placeret i små klynger. Vi passerer en stribe midterstykker til tårnene. De ankommer til Rønne i tre dele, inden de samles og rejses op ved hjælp af den chartrede, grønne 1.300 ton-kran, som man har kunnet se fra nær og fjern siden november.

En installatør er ved at gøre dem klar til monteringen. Vi kaster et hurtigt på blik på tårnets indvendige side og kan se strømkablet og den ufærdige hejsekonstruktion.

- Der bliver sat en elevator i. Den kører på den der Harald Nyborg-stige, fortæller vores lune, jyske rundviser og peger på, hvad der ligner - men helt sikkert ikke er - et spinkelt metalsystem til at bringe mandskabet op til maskinhuset og generatoren i toppen af møllen.


BØLGER I BASSINET

Vi fortsætter ned til multi purpose-kajen, som på pandemifrie somre anløbes af krydstogtskibe.

Her er underlaget lidt blødere, for bølgerne slår ind over kajen, og en del af gruset er skyllet væk. Når vinden kommer fra nordvestlig retning, har havvandet fri passage til det nye havnebassin.

- Hvis I laver indsamlinger på avisen, må I gerne samle ind til en bølgebryder, siger Bent Rasmussen.

En forlængelse af bølgebryderen er på tegnebrættet, og Rønne Havn havde før jul anden etape af havnens masterplan i udbud - endnu et anlægsprojekt til et trecifret millionbeløb.

Jeg spørger, om Siemens Gamesa har rigeligt med oplagsplads til komponenterne.

- Ikke rigeligt, men der er plads nok. Men vi har knap 180 vinger oppe i Aalborg, og dem vil vi gerne af med, siger projektlederen, der sætter stor pris på at have hele havnearealet for sig selv.

- Det er en af grundene til, at vi valgte Rønne.

Et stort, jævnt areal uden forhindringer er altafgørende til havvindmølleprojekter, ligesom kajerne skal have en høj bæreevne, og rampen skal kunne tage imod tunge ting og sager. Rønne Havns Ro-Ro-rampe skal klare over 400 ton, når Siemens Gamesas komponenter flyttes fra skib til havn, og den stærkeste kaj, hvor installationsskibet ligger, har en bæreevne på op til 50 ton per kvadratmeter.

Bent Rasmussen fremhæver endnu en fordel, som jeg ikke kendte til i forvejen; den hårde bornholmske undergrund, der betyder, at installationsskibet kan presse sine ben ned og " jacke op" uden fordyrende forberedelser.

På den danske vestkyst kræver sandbunden i havnene, at man lægger sten, hvor skibet skal stå.

" Dyrt" er et rammende tillægsord til at beskrive offshore-projekter. Alene det at samle kranen, der ankom til Rønne i mindre dele, kostede adskillige 100.000 kroner, fortæller projektlederen, da vi runder den over 100 meter høje kran på vej ud mod skibet. Vattenfalls samlede investering i Kriegers Flak-parken vurderede energiselskabet i 2018 til at være mellem 8,1 og 9,9 milliarder kroner.

Vi er nu så tæt på, at man kan se ansigtstrækkene hos de arbejdere, der fra Galløkken ligner tændstikmænd.

- Skibets besætning har blå veste på. Hvis nogle fra sitet, skal op på skibet, får de hvide veste på, så vi kan holde afstand, forklarer sikkerhedsrepræsentanten.

- Ja, det er ikke dem, du skal give en krammer, siger projektlederen om personalet i de blå veste.

Siemens Gamesa har 22 mand om bord på installationsskibet. De arbejder 14 dage ad gangen i 12 timers-skift, og udskiftningen foregår oftest via Rødvig Havn på Stevns, der ligger en times sejlads fra havvindemølleparken.

Vi er nu helt henne ved skibet og tager plads så tæt på bølgebryderen som muligt. Mandskabet er i gang med at laste vinge nummer fem ud af de tolv, der skal med. Vingen bliver kørt i stilling ved hjælp af to køretøjer. En ubemandet, fjernstyret dolly har fat nær vingespidsen, mens der sidder en fører i den specialfremstillede maskine, som skubber den let snoede vinge frem. Langsomt anbringes vingen i positionen foran skibet mellem de to grupper af lodretstående tårne. Alle behandler naturligvis komponenterne med stor forsigtighed.

Skibets kæmpekran sænker en rem ned, som bliver bundet under vingespidsen, og en mindre gul kran på kajen bliver fæstnet til den tunge, runde ende af vingen. Kranerne løfter vingen op i 30-40 meters højde, og kranføreren på kajen sætter larvefødderne i bevægelse. Hængende der i luften over os, virker den let og ligetil at håndtere, men vægten er 34 ton. Inden de ankom til Rønne, blev vingerne vejet og balanceret med vægte. De tre vinger skal veje det samme og bliver på forhånd parret med hinanden.


ERFARNE FOLK

Når alle vinger er på plads i reolsystemet på installationsskibet, bliver det de fire maskinhuses tur - eller naceller, som de kaldes. Og tidligt på morgenen næste dag skal de fire tårne sættes på plads. Hele lastningen varer under halvandet døgn, og ude på havet tager installationen af de fire møller en uges tid.

Indtil videre går arbejdet stort set gnidningsfrit, og det kan ifølge projektlederen tilskrives, at mandskabet kommer direkte fra projekter med samme mølletype i farvandet ud for Holland og Belgien, ligesom installationsskibet på den amerikanske østkyst har installeret identiske møller fra Siemens Gamesa.

Snart er femte vinge lastet, og da frostvejret begynder at bide, sætter vi kursen tilbage mod hovedkvarteret. På vejen taler vi om, at vindmøllerne bliver større og større, hvilket sætter producenterne på prøve. Kriegers Flak-møllerne har en effekt på 8,4 megawatt, men næste generation kommer op på 10-15 megawatt. I Cowis screening til energiø-projektet i Østersøen bliver det antaget, at de cirka 130 vindmøller hver skal have en effekt på 15 megawatt og få en totalhøjde på cirka 270 meter ud til vingespidsen.

Det er cirka 80 meter højere end vindmøllerne på Kriegers Flak.

Til den tid bliver der brug for endnu større installationsskibe, og transporten på landevejene i nattens mulm og mørke bliver ikke nemmere.

- Vi har revet nogle vejskilte ned mellem Brande og Esbjerg gennem årene, erkender Bent Rasmussen.


FABRIKKER VED VANDET

Tårnene er fra en fabrik i Rødekro og sejles til Rønne fra Aabenraa Havn, mens vingerne er støbt i ét stykke i Aalborg, og de er aldrig - fornuftigt nok længden på 81 meter taget i betragtning - blevet fragtet på vejnettet. To ud af nacellens tre dele, generatoren og bagenden, er bygget i Brande, mens den tredje komponent, navet, som vingerne skal sættes fast på, er produceret i den tyske havneby Cuxhaven.

Produktionsanlæggene skal befinde sig ved vandet, og havnene bør ikke være omgivet af forhindringer, og det er en anden af Rønnes fordele.

Ingen sjællandske havne har arealer, der egner sig til installations-og udskibningsopgaver.

Inden Bornholm kom på banen, blev Nyborg Havn anvendt af vindmølleproducenter, men infrastrukturen på Østfyn har visse begrænsninger.

Trelleborg er på vej med en havneudvidelse, som kan blive en konkurrent, fortæller Bent Rasmussen, og Sassnitz kan også bruges.

- Og på et tidspunkt kommer de polske havne nok også, så Rønne skal være vaks ved havelågen, siger projektlederen, som er meget tilfreds med samarbejdet med de bornholmske virksomheder og havnen.

- Her på Rønne Havn har vi fået en fantastisk service, siger han og sender rosende ord i retning af kommunen og det lokale erhvervsliv.


SENGEGARANTI

Offshore Center Bornholm, der består af en klynge virksomheder, sørger for en ordning, hvor Siemens Gamesa ikke skal forholde sig til hver pose med rundstykker og alle olieskift, som de lokale virksomheder leverer. Indkøbene samles på én regning, så mandskabet kan koncentrere sig om det vigtige. Når turister kommer til sommer, vil der stadig være sengepladser til havnens gæster.

- De garanterer os 80 senge oppe i byen hele tiden. Når vi er i den situation, hvor vi skiber ud, har vi ikke tid til at vente, påpeger Bent Rasmussen.

I første uge af februar er den aktuelle bekymring hos projektlederen vindforholdene, nævner han flere gange. Installationsarbejdet kræver et vindue, hvor vinden ikke overstiger 10-12 sekundmeter, og vejrudsigten er ikke på vindmøllesjakkets side.

Onsdagens udskibning var nummer to i rækken.

Den skal gentages 16 gange, før alle 72 møller er på plads, hvorefter Danmarks største havvindmøllepark er en realitet. Arbejdet ventes at vare helt til juli afhængig af vejret.

Et stort, jævnt areal uden forhindringer er altafgørende til havvindmølleprojekter, ligesom kajerne skal have en høj bæreevne, og rampen skal kunne tage imod tunge ting og sager. Rønne Havns Ro-Ro-rampe kan klare 400 ton, og den stærkeste kaj, hvor installationsskibet ligger, har en bæreevne på op til 50 ton per kvadratmeter.

.

    Maskinhusene øverst på møllen, hvor strømmen genereres, kaldes naceller i fagsprog. En nacelle består af tre dele, som blev samlet på Esbjerg Havn, inden de blev sejlet til Bornholm. Midterstykket er generatoren, som i modsætning til konkurrenternes modeller udmærker sig ved at være uden gear. Alle nacellerne er koblet til strøm på Rønne Havn, og de bliver løbende drejet.
    En tekniker arbejder på et tårnelement. Tårnene ankommer til Rønne i tre dele, og ved hjælp af den store BMS-krav på havnen samles tårnene og rejses op inden udskibningen.
    Kriegers Flak-projektleder Bent Rasmussen er til stede på Rønne Havn cirka en gang om måneden. Den daglige ledelse på Rønne Havn er lagt i hænderne på skiftende " site managere".
    Et lavt, fjernstyret køretøj, kaldet en " dolly", bruges til at manøvrere vingerne rundt på havnearealet.
    Mandskabet i blå veste tilhører skibets besætning. Her er en gruppe i gang med at gøre klar til at løfte en vinge ombord.
    Hver ladning med installationsskibet har plads til 12 vinger, fire tårne og fire naceller ud til havvindmølleparken. I alt skal 72 møller transporteres fra Rønne til Kriegers Flak.

Title: Rambøll skal kortlægge kabelruter fra energiø
Content:
Last December, Energinet told the feasibility studies to the Energy Islands in the Baltic Sea and the North Sea would soon be initiated. The studies must be completed by the first half of the year in 2024.

Energinet has now asked the engineering, architectural and counseling company Ramboll to map and recommend possible cable routes and landing locations for exporting electricity from the upcoming Energiø near Bornholm to Denmark and a neighboring country respectively.

This is stated on Ramboll's website.

- The task is of great, strategic importance, as the result will help to form the basis for decisions relating to the import and export of energy from the new energy island, as well as how the renewable energy from the energy islands is connected and integrated with the energy system on land. Exports of energy from the Energy Islands will connect countries on a cross and are vital when all Europeans need to have green energy, says Global Division Director for environmental impact assessment Mikkel Benthien Kristensen at Ramboll to the website.

It appears that Ramboll's long and broad experience with cable routing and environmental studies was internationally among the reasons for the choice of Ramboll. These types of studies are complex and interdisciplinary by nature and are solved in collaboration with many different specialists. The project team therefore draws on 15 experts from Ramboll in Denmark, Sweden and Germany.

The next step in the project Energiø Bornholm will be to carry out the environmental studies to ensure that the energy island has as few negative consequences for the marine environment and nature as possible, says Ramboll on its website.

    Ramboll will map and recommend possible cable routes from the upcoming Energiø near Bornholm to Denmark and a neighboring country respectively.

Title: Virtuel ekskursion til Esbjerg skaber optimisme
Content:
Bornholm can learn something from Esbjerg. This is the conclusion, according to the boards of the Business House Capital Branch at Bornholm and Business Center Bornholm as well as members of the regional municipality's finance, business and plan committee have been on virtual excursion to Esbjerg.

The southwestern city has many years of experience in the offshore area, and it can benefit Bornholm in the work of becoming the Center for Offshore Wind Energy in the Baltic Sea.

This is stated in a press release.

Title: Casper Poulsen har store planer med nabogrunden til industrikvarteret, men indtil videre har kommunen afvist at konve rtere fra landzone til erhvervsareal på grund af bekymringer for drikkevandet:Borntek-ejer: Dominoeff ekt for erhvervsgrunde bliver holdt nede
Content:
In 2017, Jeppe and Casper Poulsen, father and son, founded the company Fynegaard Erhvervs & Innovations Park ApS and bought the country estate Fynegaard, which to the west has Jensen Denmark in the industrial district as the nearest neighbor.

The family business Bornek Industri is a subcontractor to a number of companies, including Jensen, and the main purpose of becoming farm owners was to build a new factory and move Borntek out on Fynegaard's lands.

However, the visions were bigger yet. Casper and Jeppe Poulsen saw the area as the ideal place to place a business and innovation park with 7-8 hectares of buildings. In mind, they primarily had the type of companies and actors associated with Jensen's production of industrial machine machines. The benefits of creating such a business cluster would be both traditional industrial workplaces and more knowledge -heavy jobs in water technology and Cleantech.


Rejection from the regional municipality

However, Bornholm Regional Municipality did not allow to transform the land from land zone into a business zone, because on the southern part of the land there is a particularly vulnerable drinking water area.

With the drinking water as the main reasoning, the politicians in 2019 formally rejected the request, but Casper Poulsen has fought on since.

Borntek's space problem was solved in 2020, when after years of searching they managed to find suitable buildings for a factory in the industrial district in the form of Søholm property, where Bornholm's Tidende had a printing company.

- Our project was driven by our own needs, but we are also Bornholmers with big B, and we want to help create growth and year-round workplaces, says Casper Poulsen, why he continues to try to give Fynegaard Business and Innovation Park air Under the wings.

Last week he met with representatives from the regional municipality to present a new proposal for how the agricultural area can be used for the benefit of the Bornholm business community.

- Our goal is to play this plot of land again and ask the municipality to look at it seriously, says Casper Poulsen, as Bornholm's Tidende visits Borntek on Almindingsvej.


Will take into account the environment

Since the refusal in 2019, he has been thinking about how to build on the area while protecting the drinking water.

- We are open to dividing it into zones to take into account the environment, says Ole Schou Mortensen, who, as factory manager at Borntek, has helped to adapt the presentation.

Included in the meeting with the municipality they had a proposal where the plot is divided into three areas.

At the bottom of the most vulnerable area, the Poulsen family sets up to place larger stores, offices and stocks. Further up, where the land is only classified as "vulnerable", space is allocated for craftsmanship and light industry, while the area farthest to the north, up to Jensen's factory, is intended for industry.

- We are all worried about our groundwater. You shouldn't play that, but we don't think we do, says Casper Poulsen.

The business park can gradually be expanded from west to east. In the first phase, an area of ​​80,000 square meters is worked (eight hectares), while approximately 70,000 square meters have been allocated for phase two. Casper Poulsen and Ole Schou Mortensen, who both have a large interface in the Bornholm business community, are sure that the need is present. They have noticed how quickly it has recently gone to occupy larger commercial leases when premises in the Rønne area become unemployed. There is - and has been - demand from craft companies that want to move out of the center.


Make a domino effect

At Rønne Harbor, they expect more companies to come into housing.

- A further modernization of Rønne Harbor has been spent, and this may mean that some companies that are today at the harbor will have to search away, says Casper Poulsen about the companies that do not deal with decided port activity .

In addition, Casper Poulsen and Ole Schou Mortensen know for several larger sales ware stores who want to establish themselves in Rønne, but where investors have not been able to find suitable grounds. Casper Poulsen believes that the Fynegaard grounds will be suitable for the space-intensive branch of retail.

- You get a really good exposure on Aakirkebyvej. It is probably Bornholm's most traveled road, he says.

For this type of shop, the municipality has designed the area along Aakirkebyvej between Alminding's Roundabout and Sagavej. However, there will only be space if or when the existing companies in the area that Jensen and Borntek can move out of this part of the city. And that is why Casper Poulsen believes that it should be in the municipality's clear interest that new land is made available to several types of businesses so that a domino effect can be started.

- You have no idea what you have missed because there have been no available business reasons, he says.


See options, not restrictions

In Herning he owns the metal company Mill-Turn, and over the years he has become accustomed to a different service from Herning Municipality than at home on the food island.

- Here the administration runs in a completely different gear, says Casper Poulsen, pointing out that competition with neighboring municipalities helps to make the service of business much sharper in Jutland and Zealand municipalities than is the case with Bornholm Regional Municipality.

- They see opportunities - not restrictions, he explains.

In the past years, Casper Poulsen does not feel that interest in business has been particularly great at the regional municipality. He has held meetings with unprepared top officials who had not read the material sent in advance, and it was very difficult to be squeezed into Winni Grosbøll's calendar when she was mayor. In 2019, politicians were rejecting the project blankly based on the administration's recommendation until Thomas Thors in the eleventh hour intervened and tried to find an alternative solution. The intervention led to a compromise for a period of time which involved an area exchange. The municipality offered an area on the opposite side of Aakirkebyvej, where the same consideration was to be expelled for the drinking water.

However, this barter was abandoned because the municipality would first lay out the land to a business zone so that it could be sold at a higher square price with the tariff for commercial grounds.

Casper Poulsen hopes that replacement at the mayor's post, in the planning department and his fashioned proposals for the use of the land will give the project on Fynegaard's agricultural land another chance of being converted to commercial area.

- I have told Thomas Thors that the politicians basically just have to create a good framework for a playground - then the traders come and offer themselves, says the director.

Our project was driven by our own needs, but we are also Bornholmers with great B, and we want to help create growth and year -round workplaces.

Casper Poulsen Company Fynegaard Business & Innovations Park ApS.


It writes Fynegaard Business & Innovation's Park in the proposal to the municipality

“The new area ensures a future framework for developing the profession on Bornholm, especially with a focus on the industry, including in particular the manufacture of industry with exports.

The location with neighbor to Bornholm's largest export business ensures their development opportunities, but is also intended to form the framework for a future "cluster" based on existing companies, future subcontractors, or spin offog startups.

Furthermore, the area could secure the framework for new companies within Greentech, or energy, based on the starting point as Bornholms as a test and energy island, and Energi Hub.

The area close to Aakirkebyvej is wanted to be able to accommodate larger chain companies that have expressed themselves to establish themselves on Bornholm.

Owner wants to plot the farm "Fynegaard", separately and apply it for private residence. You want any. Later to apply for the redevelopment and layout of 3-4 new holiday apartments, in an existing barn building.

The business area is thought to be divided into three areas, and divided into two phases, in total the area is approx. 15 hectares where phase 1 is approx. 8 acres.

However, the area is to be laid out together from the start and expanded according to ongoing needs. "

Title: Energiø kan blive del af europæisk netværk
Content:
It's about integrating offshore wind effective and safe into the European electricity grid when seven transmission system operators join forces for the launch of Eurobar. It is an initiative for the interconnection of offshore wind parks throughout Europe, and one of the German participants has a look at the energy island at Bornholm.

This is stated in a press release from 50 Hertz Transmission in Berlin.

- Our finished Kriegers Flak - Combined Grid Solution project together with Energinet, which involves three offshore wind farms and two countries, points in the right way. We will build on this and jointly implement the Bornholm Energiø project if it is financially and technically feasible. This would then be the second electric hub in the Baltic Sea and a plan for electricity grid at sea, says 50 Hertz Transmission CFO Marco Nix, in the press release.

In the future, Eurobar can develop into a linked offshore network, according to the press release.

The initiative aims to support Europe and its transmission system operators in a safe and effective connection to offshore wind farms by striving for standardization of interfaces and technology, reducing the environmental impact and interconnecting offshore wind clusters.

Thus, the mission of the Eurobar initiative is to develop and implement a common approach to offshore infrastructure systems that connect the future offshore capacity to Europe's transmission system.

    The energy island at Bornholm can become part of a European network of offshore wind parks.

Title: Vækstteam Bornholm har afleveret sin anbefalinger til regeringen: Grøn energi skal være fremtidens erhvervsfyrtårn
Content:
How is it best invested in local business forces and potentials that can develop into commercial lighthouses? Seven regional growth teams will try to answer that question, and the Bornholm Growth Team came on Monday with his recommendations to Business Minister Simon Kollerup.

The headline is Bornholm as the Baltic Lighthouse for the utilization of green energy from offshore wind turbines, according to a press release.

Green energy must thus be the commercial fireplace of the future on Bornholm. With the climate agreement from 2020, the island has been designated as the home of one of the world's first two green energy islands.

With this starting point, the Growth Team therefore proposes that a national test center be developed for green energy on Bornholm.

The growth team also recommends that Bornholm get its own business, knowledge and development environment with local, national and international companies. It also points out that Bornholm can become a hub for the offshore market in the Baltic Sea, and that the island can generally play a role as a green, maritime transport hub for shipping in the Baltic Sea.

- Bornholm is already 100 percent self -sufficient with green energy, and as Energiø Bornholm comes to supply green electricity, not only to the rest of Denmark, but hopefully also to Europe. With its unique position, Bornholm has the potential to become a hub for sustainable energy production, which will contribute to the green transition and have significant business potentials for the island. As a prerequisite for this, we also recommend that efforts are made to develop competence among employees and digital transition in companies, says chairman Henriette Hallberg Thygesen from the Bornholm Growth Team in the press release.


A real priority

Mayor Thomas Thors (S) as chairman of the board of the Business House Capital's branch at Bornholm was appointed to participate as a member of Growth Team Bornholm.

- Growth team Bornholm has, with our recommendations, given great recognition of the work that Bornholm has done in recent decades for precisely the green transition.

In addition, our recommendations point out that Bornholm commercially to take advantage of the possibilities in Energiø Bornholm to create a commercial lighthouse that can drive a great development on Bornholm. In my opinion, it is a real priority that lies in the recommendations, and I am glad that the government now, with the recommendations in hand, can back purposefully to make the ambitious project ideas succeed, he says in the press release.

In the government, Business Minister Simon Kollerup (S) is looking forward to reading the recommendations of Bornholm and the other regional growth teams.

- During the Corona crisis, the Danish social model has seriously shown its worth, where we have collaborated across and together created new solutions that also make our country more prepared for the future. The same goes for our seven regional growth teams, where we have got some of the people who know their local area best to help us develop the local business forces.

We must take advantage of the fact that our companies can do something different in both North Jutland, Bornholm and Funen. That is why I am very much looking forward to reading each team's recommendations so that we can jointly start the local growth and create new jobs throughout the country, he says in the press release.

With its unique position, Bornholm has the potential to become a hub for sustainable energy production.

Henriette Hallberg Thygesen Chairman, Growth Team Bornholm.

Title: Energiø kalder på arbejdskraft: 200-400 årsværk kan blive lokal arbejdskraft
Content:
Energiø and Wind farms offer some very special opportunities for new jobs at Bornholm in the coming years. It shows a new analysis from the consultancy company COWI for the regional labor council for Bornholm, which uncovers the need for labor in connection with the establishment of Energiø Bornholm.

This is stated in a press release.

The Regional Labor Market Council, together with the regional municipality and the partners in the project, has been ready for Energiø Bornholm to focus on the need for labor, the upgrading of the workforce and the help of local businesses, so that they are ready to seize the possibilities so that the projects have the greatest possible effect and value for Bornholm.

The construction work in connection with the Energy Island will start as planned in 2028.


Permanent jobs for operation

According to the analysis, the total direct work craft demand is expected to be approximately 14,500 full -time equivalents. The analysis shows that the suppliers are largely expected to bring their own labor to the installation of the mills. But there will be demand for labor from the subcontractors of goods and services.

Overall, an indirect work craft demand of over 11,000 man -years is expected by the subcontractors. In particular, there will be demand for skilled workers with an office or retail education, skilled blacksmiths, mechanics, industrial technicians and CNC technicians as well as electricians.

About 200-400 man-years throughout the period, according to the analysis, can become local labor from Bornholm. These jobs are expected primarily to relate to accommodation and catering, trade and transport as well as minor repair tasks. The analysis also points out that in the longer term there will be demand for, for example, electricians, mechanics, blacksmiths and meats for permanent jobs in connection with the operation of the energy island.


Qualifying unemployed

The Regional Labor Market Council for Bornholm has no doubt that Energiø Bornholm will create growth on the island. Therefore, according to the Council, it is highly relevant to increase the approach to vocational education at Bornholm and to get attracted and maintained qualified labor, not least in the light of the falling adolescents.

That agenda is the chairman of the regional labor market council on Bornholm, Jens Christian Olsen, very busy.

- Bornholm's biggest challenge is a lack of skilled labor.

We are working to motivate young people to take a vocational education and on recruiting and qualifying unemployed and employed so that we can staff the tasks we have on the island. To help ensure the necessary qualified labor in connection with the work around Energiø Bornholm is one of our primary focus areas in the regional labor council on Bornholm in the coming years, he says in the press release.

We are working to motivate young people to take a vocational education and on recruiting and qualifying unemployed and employed.

Title: Grønne gæster
Content:

The first we gave the headline "Consortium will make Bornholm a green gas station", and then you could think "yes yes, aha, that's what we should be!".

Should you find that view a little questionable, and you could also see that Bornholm may also be anything other than that, of course it is not so dramatic even.

Bornholm will always be more and more than the new, green and climate friendly. But fortunately Bornholm is also about to be all that. On the contrary, because at a time when more and more English is penetrating our language, it may still be necessary to look to see that "bunkering" means fuel supply of ships and that the word goes back to the steamship era where fuel to shipping was stored in something reminiscent of just bunkers.

"Hub" means a hub, so all in all we end up in "fuel supply hub", a dangerous long word, but when only the actors can find it in it themselves, then it goes well.

Ørsted, Haldor Topsøe and Ramboll are giants in Denmark.

Finally, Bunker Holding Group is actually also Danish, but with 66 offices in 33 countries.

We might as well get used to it, and fortunately it is ultra-positive: We are visited by the very big players in the new green market. They have a look at Bornholm, and more of that kind of thing has to bring more. Job, for example, and newcomers. It can soon become difficult to preserve pessimism.

Also smaller actors are passing by. It is just as gratifying, also because they can appear closer to us, even more relevant. It must now be tested on Bornholm for two years, so that not a great deal among us will pass by the Green Solution House and Campus, which will alternately act as hosts for this gigabattery? Bornholm's green guests will be in line. Let's do as you always have done on Bornholm: Receive with open arms, great hospitality and all necessary help.

It can only be good.

Bornholm will always be more and more than the new, green and climate friendly.

But fortunately Bornholm is also about to be all that.

Title: Placering gør Bornholm ideel som knudepunkt for grønne energiløsninger: Konsortium vil gøre Bornholm til en grøn tankstation
Content:
Bornholm Bunker Hub is the name of a new consortium, where several international players test the possibility of establishing a gas station with green ship fuel on Bornholm.

This is stated in a press release.

The consortium has just initiated a preliminary study to clarify the financial potential of delivering sustainable fuels to the more than 60,000 ships that pass Bornholm in the middle of the Baltic Sea every year.

Fuels produced using offshore wind energy.

- We see great potential in utilizing Bornholm as an energy island to meet the Danish government's ambitious target of reducing CO2 emissions. Denmark has a unique opportunity to create an industrial strength position in the production of sustainable fuels for heavy transport and create jobs in the process. Bornholm's strategic location also makes it ideal as a hub for green energy solutions, and we look forward to exploring the potential for delivering sustainable fuels to shipping from Bornholm, says Anders Nordstrøm, head of Ørsted's activities in hydrogen and power-to-X, in the press release.

Power-to-X is thus a unified term for technologies where electricity production is transformed into hydrogen, synthetic gases, fuels or chemicals.

Rønne Harbor is one of eight actors in the consortium behind Bornholm Bunker Hub.

- We see great opportunities for Bornholm to use its central position as a hub where ships in the future can refill sustainable fuels, says CEO Thomas Bendtsen in Rønne Harbor in the press release.

Bornholm is centrally located in terms of being able to exploit the great potential for green electricity from offshore wind throughout the Baltic Sea region.

This means that Bornholm can become a unique energy center that utilizes regional energy resources to reduce CO2 emissions in society, including among shipping, according to the press release.

Bornholm's strategic location also makes it ideal as a hub for green energy solutions, and we look forward to exploring the potential for delivering sustainable fuels to shipping from Bornholm.

Anders Nordstrøm Head of Ørsted's activities in hydrogen and Power-to-X.

Title: Debat om fremtidens energi på Bornholm: Enighed om visionen men ikke om farten

For him, it cannot go fast enough to move on with the cables, both the big one for the upcoming energy island, which will be established 20 kilometers from Bornholm, and a new, more robust sea cable for Sweden.

Title: Dan Jørgensen på besøg: Uvist om Bornholm får strøm fraenergiø
Content:
Climate Minister Dan Jørgensen (S) struck a stroll past Bornholm on Thursday in connection with the National Assembly.

A busy minister has to feel a busy plan too. First he made his way past Rønne Harbor to take a look at the leading port of the future.

Later, he could find him at the main scene of the National Assembly, where he made a conversation about the government's climate goals and the hot topics of the climate debate-energy islands and power-to-x.

Fortunately, Bornholm's Tidende managed to catch him between the many plans for a talk about just the energy island, and what he thinks Bornholm gets out of laying the island for the world's first and non-artificial energy island.

All eyes on Bornholm To understand how important and big the whole project around the energy island is, according to Dan Jørgensen, you have to see it all in a historical perspective. As many are familiar with, Denmark was the first country in the world to make an offshore wind farm in 1991. Back then, it resonated in the world and people were uncertain about what it would come along, but it should show that offshore wind turbines could be A large part of the solution to the climate crisis.

- And why then start there?, Dan Jørgensen asks himself and continues: - Now we take the first step again by making two energy islands. One becomes an artificial island in the North Sea, and the other becomes so Bornholm, which can be realized the fastest by the two. That is to say that it is historically what is going on. So Bornholm helps to write world history, he says.

According to the climate minister, there is no doubt that a lot of attention is being paid to Bornholm, which he believes will divert a lot of positive effects.

- As you can see already, it will divert a lot of employment and jobs and generally create an even stronger branding of Bornholm. It's going to be a huge scoop for Bornholm, says Dan Jørgensen.

Not in my backyard The Minister of Climate, as expected, sees the vast majority of positive effects for Bornholm by being upcoming Energiø. Title: Grønt lys til forundersøgelse for energiø
Content:
On June 21, 2021, the Danish Energy Agency has given Energinet permission to carry out preliminary studies at sea for the energy island and the upcoming offshore wind farms in the Baltic Sea. This is stated in a press release from the Danish Energy Agency.

The permit is valid from June 21, 2021 to 31 December 2023 and does not in itself give the right to erect offshore wind farms in the areas. However, the permit gives Energinet the right to collect relevant information about the feasibility study area at sea.

- Based on the permit, Energinet will send ships in the Baltic Sea to investigate and measure the seabed in the feasibility study areas where the two offshore wind farms can be placed. At the same time, Environmental is also investigating Energinet the feasibility study, where, among other things, wildlife studies are conducted, the press release states.

Preliminary studies on land later come the two offshore wind farms must be linked to an energy island on Bornholm.

However, feasibility studies will not include this part of the project, where these initial studies on land will have to be carried out later.

However, a total strategic environmental assessment (SME) of the Energy Island and offshore wind farms will be made, which the feasibility studies will be able to contribute to.

At the same time, the feasibility studies will also contribute to the fact that the offshore wind farms can be established with the least possible risk of the winner of the supply.

This risk minimization is expected to give lower bid prices.

The winner's winner can also use the environmental studies for the later environmental impact assessment (EIA) of the specific project at sea.

When the offshore wind farms are finished, they will have a capacity of 2 gigawatts.

Later in the year, the Danish Energy Agency will initiate the strategic environmental assessment (SMEs) of the Energiøen on Bornholm and the offshore wind farms, and a consultation process is expected at the end of 2021/ Primo 2022, the press release states.

Title: Landstrøm versus Rønne Havn
Content:
When Bornholm seeks to profile itself as the Green Island in every way, it seems strange that the director of Rønne Harbor, Mr. Thomas Bendtsen, to TV2 states that after Max's transition to Landstrøm, no further action will take place for the establishment of the creation of Landstrøm to other ships that had to call Rønne Harbor. The rationale should be that other technologies are expected to "overtake" wind -based rural power.

The good question is; What technologies are the director thinking about and if so, what is the time horizon, 5 -10 -20 years? Whatever one may develop of alternative fuels, it will not match an immediate transition to wind -based rural power for all ships. The fact that funding should be a problem is a bad excuse.

The project can be self -financed with higher electricity prices for the ships over a given number of years. With the resources the harbor has available, as well as the growth rate that is prospected, after Bornholm is officially declared Denmark and the Baltic Sea Energea # 1, I think the director's attitude is a mockery, not only against the island's citizens, but also towards the whole of Denmark's green transition process .
