Title: Kun EL og V siger nej: Fire skal arbejde på fuld tid med energiø
Content:
The municipality gets a decided secretariat of four people who have to work exclusively with the energy island.

On Thursday evening, the Unity List and the Left formally stood outside the agreement that the municipal council's five other parties have reached around the upcoming energy island.

By contrast, the Conservatives, the Social Democracy, the Danish People's Party, the Bornholmer List and the Christian Democrats together held together to put 16 of the municipal council's 23 mandates behind the municipality that the municipality is now given a decided secretariat of four people who have to work exclusively with the energy island.

The three new employees will be hired already. Whether the municipality should hire them all immediately or wait for autumn negotiations on next year's very problematic municipal budget led to some debate in the City Council Hall in Rønne on Thursday.

All the municipal council's parties Vote tea to play the more long -term financing of the municipality's secretariat for the energy island into the negotiations on the next municipal budget. But not everyone could approve to start immediately and let the municipal treasury pay the first year of the three new employees in the Secretariat for Energiøen.

- In light of the fact that the Finance Committee has just ordered a savings catalog of DKK 119 million, I think we should see this in the light of what we also spend money on in the municipality, said group chairman Morten Riis (EL).

Kirstine van Sabben (BL), on the other hand, opened for four municipal employees to work exclusively with the energy island may only be sufficient for a start.

- It may also be that it will be the three that you start with. We would like to help attract something more to Bornholm, and that Bornholm gets more out of being Energiø Kirstine van Sabben, she said.

Jonna Nielsen (Loose) found the opposite that four employees will be many to put out.

- Can't we start with one employee? When we come to the budget negotiations, we may know more precisely how many are needed, she said.

Conservatives, the Danish People's Party, the Social Democracy and the Christian Democrats were without reservation.

"I have become absolutely convinced that it is crucial that we make a special effort in relation to the energy island," said Mayor Jacob Trøst (K).

- It is insanely important that we at Bornholm are active participants and not just spectators to the energy island. But that we take advantage of the maximum opportunities that come around finances, jobs, education and housing, said group chairman Claus Larsen-Jensen (S).

- We have been around in a number of places and see large plants for green transition: Esbjerg, Skive, Aabenraa and Fredericia. The conclusion from those places is that you underestimate the tasks that come with this. It requires a crew that lifts that task, he continued.

- We need to make a special effort. We cannot only use what the state gives us. This is one of the big, important points. What we can afford in the budget, we must look at afterwards, said Bjarne Hartung Kirkegaard (KD).

The municipality's secretariat for the energy island comes after the municipal director Sine Sunesen in the agenda for Thursday's meeting had decided on the alarm that today's one energy island employee is on an impossible task of lifting a piece of work that extends over almost all of the municipal fields. And that the workload has now reached an extent where the municipality's top official can no longer guarantee that all Bornholm's interests are actually taken care of.

"The tasks are many, and these are complex agendas that need to be analyzed, operated and disseminated on an ongoing basis in order for Bornholm's interest to be taken care of. There is current organization several of the agendas have to be prioritized due to lack of resources," wrote Sine Sunesen in the meeting prelude.

"The consequence is that Bornholm's interests are not certainly involved in the decisions, which is at best inappropriate, and at worst counterproductive to realize the political ambitions of the island. Therefore, a new and sustainable organization should be invested." she continued.

"Energiø Bornholm becomes one of Denmark's most crucial infrastructure projects and will involve the production of green energy at an unprecedented scale".

"With Energiø Bornholm - as well as Ørsted and CIP's plans for two more large offshore wind farms - Bornholm is facing historically large investments that allow for new energy production, new jobs and new investments. For Bornholm to seize the unique and green development opportunities, there is Need for political leadership in the field and a new organization around the work with Energiø Bornholm, ”the municipal director also wrote.

"Working with Energiø Bornholm will, among other things, help to Safe Bornholm's social and economic sustainability, and that Bornholm succeeds in attracting businesses, labor and new citizens."

All the municipal council's parties vot tea to play the longer -term financing of the municipality's secret Tariat for Energiøen into the negotiations on the next municipal budget.

Title: Folk skal have en ordentlig erstatning
Content:
Neighbors of the land plant must be able to get compensation or relinquish their house to a value similar to what it was worth if no land facility was placed.

In connection with Energinet's report on the location of the land plant to the energy island, neighbors and others have understandably expressed concern about the value of their property. I understand that concern and agree with.

They have been unsuccessful in a situation that the state (the Folketing) has decided that Energinet should establish an energy island at and on Bornholm, which means that a large land plant must be established in South Bornholm, because Denmark and Europe must be switched to green energy in The site of fossil fuels such as oil and gas from Russia and other oil states. That conversion has a price. It requires that green plants be established to be placed.

And it will be for Denmark's first energy island in Sydbornholm.

The existing legislation does not take into account that you, as a neighbor to such a plant, can get a replacement while you could get it if wind turbines and solar cells were established. It's not fair. The people who become neighbors to the new land plant should not lose the value of their house because they happen to end up in this situation.

Therefore, of course, they have to shout about it.

My and the Social Democracy position is that it must be corrected legislative. Neighbors of the land plant must be able to get compensation or relinquish their house to a value similar to what it was worth if no land facility was placed.

Bornholm's two members of parliament, Lea Wermelin (S) and Peter Juul-Jensen (V), have grabbed the case. They are both members of parties sitting in the government and they have promised that the case is being dealt with seriously there. A solution must be found.

In the political discussions that have been and are on Bornholm, we have been focused on solving that problem. It is a pity that it is not resolved before Energinet made their report on the location of the land plant.

I/ we have the view that when the state, as part of the green transition, decides for such large plants, then proper compensation must also be paid to those who relinquish land directly to the plant, in connection with the neighbors. There are such large billion investments, it is pure peanuts it costs to treat people properly. I hope the Folketing gets this in place as soon as possible. One can be nothing else to know about the people in question.

Title: Det er bornholmerne, der beslutter, om vi skal have power-to-x-anlæg
Content:
We do not expect that in politicians, technical insight, but we expect you to have allied you with someone who has.

Reply to Claus Larsen-Jensen regarding the answer to our reader letter of March 9.

First of all, I would like to correct a misunderstanding.

I am certainly not against a comprehensive plan for the energy island. On the contrary, I think it is high time that politicians come up with their ideas and visions. And a plan.

I point out that the Social Democracy's overall plan for the energy island is welcome. But that as a citizen I have objections.

First, that politicians' presentation is too nuanced, idyllicing positive. And secondly, under no circumstances do I want Power-to-X on Bornholm.

I am fully aware that the state is in charge of the offshore wind farm south of Bornholm and the Transformer Station. This is how we are - we are without influence. And it may prove to be a great opportunity for Bornholm in order to add new business opportunities to the island with everything it can result in increased revenue, relocation, educational opportunities and more.

But Power-to-X system on our small island? It is probably us Bornholmers who can decide.

Your answer to us in the Journal 13 March suggests that you/ your politicians colleagues have not made you concrete thoughts of or gained concrete knowledge of what it entails to establish Power-to-X facilities on Bornholm. We actually asked some direct questions in the reader letter, and the one answer you gave was a very diffuse answer to how the water consumption for a power-to-X system could be taken into account.

We do not expect that in politicians, technical insight, but we expect you to have allied you with someone who has. And that you will currently be able to be more concrete and sharp, both on your goals and methods.

Where should a power-to-X system be? How much will it fill? Are more than one plant considered? What risks will there be? What about the colossal amount of surplus heat? These are questions, among many others that ordinary people care about, and which you should have answers to before making decisions It is extremely unsafe for us citizens to have the feeling that our politicians are so pressed by the current financial conditions And then seduced by the future economic opportunities that they uncritically take on the yes-hat and make decisions that are unexplained and have incomprehensible consequences far into the future. Also negative consequences!.

Title: Energiø og klimaplan udløste magtkamp og politisk armlægning
Content:
Det handlede om at handle grønt og klimavenligt. Men det kom også til at handle om, hvem der bestemmer, da kommunalbestyrelsen torsdag aften lod to grønne sager vikle sig godt og grundigt ind i hinanden.

Hvad vil det sige at være grøn og klimavenlig? Hvornår er man mest klimavenlig og grøn? Og hvad skal pengene bruges på, når man nu gerne vil være det? De spørgsmål blev de centrale, da to sager helt usædvanligt viklede sig sammen og blev til én sag torsdag aften i kommunalbestyrelsen.

Først var det sagen om at sætte fire medarbejdere i kommunen af til arbejdet med den kommende energiø. Og så var det sagen om at prøve at sætte Bornholms CO2-udslip ned - ved at sætte to medarbejdere af til det fortsatte arbejde med kommunens klimaplan.

I alt seks medarbejdere. Men dels har kommunen ikke mange penge, og dels har to næsten lige store dele af kommunalbestyrelsen to forskellige svar på de her spørgsmål.

At Bornholm får mest muligt ud af energiøen er vigtigst, mener Konservative, Socialdemokratiet, Dansk Folkeparti, Bornholmerlisten og Kristendemokraterne.

Men nej: At sætte handling bag planen om at sætte Bornholms CO2-udslip ned er vigtigere, svarer Enhedslisten, Venstre og løsgængeren Jonna Nielsen.

Torsdag aften så begge grupper på hver sine tidspunkter ud til at trække det længste strå. Det gik sådan her til: .


VI FJERNER NOGLE PENGE

Før kommunalbestyrelsen trådte sammen, havde økonomiudvalget mødtes ekstraordinært.

Efter Jonna Nielsen farvel til Socialdemokratiet er Socialdemokratiet ikke længere repræsenteret i økonomiudvalget, for den plads har Jonna Nielsen beholdt.

Jonna Nielsen viste sig torsdag aften at være på linje med Enhedslisten og Venstre i spørgsmålet om, hvordan kommunen skal forholde sig til energiøen: Afventende, uden at tage store skridt her og nu.

Sammen med Enhedslisten og Venstre udgjorde Jonna Nielsen derfor et flertal i økonomiudvalget for ikke at sætte fire af kommunens medarbejdere af til energiøen.

Men kun én ekstra medarbejder. Finansieret af kommunekassen resten af året.

Hvad angår næste år og fremad havde EL, V og Jonna Nielsen flertal i økonomiudvalget for at sende sagen ind i det store kompleks om næste års pressede kommunebudget.

Men selvom EL, V og Jonna Nielsen udgør et flertal i økonomiudvalget, gør de det ikke i selve kommunalbestyrelsen. Her kan de kun tælle til 10 af de i alt 23 mandater.

Ud over at Socialdemokratiet ikke sidder i økonomiudvalget, gør Bornholmerlisten og Kristendemokraterne det heller ikke.

Derfor blev tingene vendt på hovedet stort set med det samme, efter at den samlede kommunalbestyrelse var begyndt at behandle sagen om at sætte flere medarbejdere af til energiøen.


VI FLYTTER NOGLE PENGE

Det sørgede Linda Kofoed Persson (DF) for.

Med et forslag, der i praksis viklede sagen om energiø-sekretariatet ind i sagen om kommunens klimaplan. For hendes forslag gik ud på at flytte penge fra klimaplanen og i stedet bruge dem på medarbejdere til energiøen.

- Med energiøen står vi over for en af vores fornemste opgaver, og det er at sikre, at Bornholm, bornholmerne, øen og erhvervslivet får indflydelse og del i kagen. Vi står over for en stor opgave, som der skal bruges nogle medarbejdere til. Men vi står også over for et skarpt budget. Og så står man med de her to vægtskåle og skal finde ud af, hvad der vejer mest, sagde hun.

- Derfor kommer jeg nu lidt sent med et andet forslag, som skal lyde på, at i sagen om klimaplanen, som vi behandler senere, har vi nogle midler til overs fra da vi lavede energipolitikken. Der er 963.000 kroner til overs, som man nu foreslår at bruge til klimaplanen.

- Jeg foreslår, at vi vælger at bruge dem her i stedet for, så de overførte midler fra energipolitikken afsætter vi her og nu til energiø-sekretariatet. Og så bruger vi, hvis det er nødvendigt, 637.000 kroner fra kommunekassen til energiø-sekretariatet i stedet for at bruge 1,5 millioner, sagde Linda Kofoed Persson.

- Jeg mener faktisk, at vores energiø er en mere presserende opgave end klimaplanen, og derfor mener jeg, at vi skal bruge de penge her - og så sende hele finansieringen af klimaplanen ind i budgetforhandlingerne, som vi skal have lidt senere på året.

Enhedslisten var tydeligt overrasket. Det var flere andre også: Var det hele nu ved at blive vendt på hovedet? HVAD VIL SOCIALDEMOKRATIET? Første parti på podiet derefter: Bornholmerlisten.

Med støtte til Linda Kofoed Persson.

- Vi er godt klar over, at vi skal ud og spare rigtig mange penge. Men vi vil også gerne være med til at gøre kagen større. Og det kan det her måske netop være med til at sikre: At vi på den her måde får tiltrukket noget mere til Bornholm, sagde gruppeformand Kirstine van Sabben (BL).

- I forhold til Dansk Folkepartis forslag til finansiering synes jeg egentlig, at det lyder ret fornuftigt. Vi har nogle kan-opgaver, og vi har nogle skal-opgaver, og klimaplanen kan vi sagtens skubbe, uden at der sker noget ved det, sagde hun dernæst.

Straks derefter: Socialdemokratiet. Hvis tre mandater det er meget, meget svært for alle de seks andre partier at være foruden, hvis de vil have noget igennem. For en offensiv bornholmsk indsats omkring energiøen - men også partner med Enhedslisten om dette års kommunebudget.

Så hvilken vej ville Socialdemokratiet nu gå? - Energiøen er en historisk stor milliardinvestering, der sker på Bornholm. Det er sindssygt vigtigt, at vi som Bornholm, som bornholmere og som kommunalbestyrelse er med i det, der sker, og ikke bare er passive modtagere af noget, som nogle andre kommer og planter hos os, sagde gruppeformand Claus Larsen-Jensen (S).

- Vi får etableret det landanlæg, men det vigtige er, at vi ikke kun bliver en grøn stikkontakt, men også udnytter de maksimale muligheder der er for udvikling på Bornholm.

Det giver et løft til Bornholm, som bliver mærkbart omkring økonomi, job, uddannelse, boliger.

- Vi har været rundt i en række kommuner: I Esbjerg, i Skive, i tirsdags var vi i Aabenraa. Vi har været i Fredericia og set store solcelleanlæg og power-to-x anlæg og alt muligt andet. Og hvad er konklusionen derfra? Det er, at man undervurderer de opgaver, der følger af, at sådan noget skal ske.

- Skal vi udvikle noget, så skal vi i virkeligheden erobre lokomotivet i forhold til den forandrings-togrejse, som vi er på. Og det kræver altså et mandskab, der kan løfte den her opgave. Derfor er vi tilhænger af den indstilling, der ligger fra kommunaldirektøren, sagde Claus Larsen-Jensen. Og fortsatte: - .... og hvis det er nødvendigt for at sikre pengene til det, accepterer vi det forslag, som Linda Kofoed Persson er kommet med.

Vi må så skubbe den opgave med klimaplanen til budgetforhandlingerne.

- Linda, jeg er også helt med på at skubbe pengene fra klimaplanen herover. For når jeg vejer de to ting op over for hinanden, så er energiøen vigtigst lige nu og her, sagde dernæst Bjarne Hartung Kirkegaard (KD).


ALT VENDT PÅ HOVEDET

Bum. Nu pludselig flertal for " den fulde pakke", som Kirstine van Sabben kaldte den: Fire medarbejdere i et sekretariat helliget energiøen. Og bum bum: Ikke længere penge nok til at arbejde videre med klimaplanen som planlagt.

Enhedslisten var rystet. Gruppeformand Morten Riis (EL) talte først i flere minutter uden at komme ind på, at alting lige var blevet vendt på hovedet. Han talte derimod om den oprindelige plan om at lade kommunekassen betale for energiø-sekretariatet.

Selvom kassetrækket lige var blevet mere end halveret ved at tilføre arbejdet med energiøen de 963.000 ubrugte kroner, som der kort forinden havde stået " klimaplan" på.

- Vi er ikke begejstrede for, at vi skal tage penge ud af kassen for at finansiere opstarten af nogle stillinger på den her måde. Det her med at give tillægsbevillingen ud af kassen er noget, som man skal være lidt varsom med, sagde Morten Riis.

Energiøen vil forværre Bornholms klimaregnskab, sagde han også. For eksempel vil det kræve rigtig megen transport til og fra, når komponenter til landanlægget og måske også mere end det skal fragtes til Bornholm.

- I forhold til Dansk Folkepartis finansieringsforslag er det jo faktisk sådan, at etableringen af energiøen kommer til at øge vores CO2-udslip. I og med at vindmøllerne ikke kommer til at stå på Bornholm, kommer vi klimaregnskabsmæssigt ikke til at have nogen fordel af det. Det kommer ikke til at figurere under vores klimaregnskab, sagde Morten Riis.

- Derimod vil alt hvad det kræver at etablere energiøen belaste vores klimaregnskab.

Så at finansiere med pengene til klimaplanen forværrer sådan set bare vores aktuelle klimaregnskab.

Men da var løbet kørt. Kort efter stemte et flertal på 13 (Konservative, Dansk Folkeparti, Socialdemokratiet, Bornholmerlisten og Kristendemokraterne) energiø-sekretariatet igennem. Og klimaplanen ind i den dybe uvished, der omgærder næste års kommunebudget.


BORNHOLM ER IKKE GRØN

En halv time passerede, før sagen om klimaplanen kom op. Eller hvad der nu var tilbage af den sag. Pengene til at virkeliggøre planen for var jo lige forsvundet. Men Enhedslisten gik til modangreb, nu med Helle Munk Ravnborg, til daglig for enden af bordet i udvalget for natur, miljø og plan.

- Kommunalbestyrelsen har lige for en time siden besluttet, at vi ikke vil være en af de kommuner, der sætter handling bag ord.

Vi laver en klimaplan, fint, men vi gider sådan set ikke at føre den ud i livet. Så så meget for den grønne ø, hvis man følger den indstilling, der kommer fra René Danielsson - og så hult vil det klinge, når vi prøver at markedsføre os som en grøn ø, sagde hun.

- Det er klart, at energiøen kan man sige rigtig meget godt om. Men én ting man ikke kan sige er, at den hjælper til at sænke Bornholms CO2-aftryk. Tværtimod kommer energiøen til at øge vores CO2-aftryk i en god del år frem i tiden. Og det er i de år, at vi har brug for, at vi gør alt hvad vi kan for at reducere vores klimapåvirkning. Ellers kommer det til at gå rigtig galt, ikke bare for vores børnebørn, men også for os lige nu og her, for vores erhverv, for vores landbrug på den her ø.

- Så jeg er rigtig trist over den manglende vilje til at sætte handling bag ord. Den manglende vilje ved at lave en plan og så bare droppe at gennemføre den, sagde Helle Munk Ravnborg.

- Det synes jeg er ynkeligt. Jeg synes, at det er spild af borgernes penge, og jeg synes, at det er meget beskæmmende. Og jeg vil anholde hver eneste gang der er en politiker her, der prøver at påstå, at vi er en grøn ø, for det kan vi sørme ikke med nogen ret hævde, at vi er længere.


SVAR PÅ TILTALE

Det var der des uagtet nogle, der gerne ville påstå. Med det samme.

- Jeg synes måske nok, at du er meget kras, Helle, når du siger " vi gider ikke" og " manglende vilje". Helle, det er ikke det, som det handler om. Det handler om, at når vi skal veje to vægtskåle med energiøen og klimaplanen, så var jeg nødt til at vægte energiøen lidt højere. Og så vente en lille smule med klimaplanen, sagde Bjarne Hartung Kirkegaard.

- Jeg synes ikke, at det er helt fair, Helle.

At udlægge konklusionen på den måde, som du gør. Det her handler om prioritering, sagde Claus Larsen-Jensen.

- Vi vælger en finansieringsmodel, hvor vi kan sikre, at sekretariatet til energiøen kommer igenne,. Og så siger vi samtidig, at vi ikke udskyder klimaplanen ret mange måneder, men tager den diskussion ved budgetforhandlingerne, sagde han også.

- Vi negligerer og tilsidesætter ikke alt det, der skal laves i forhold til klimaplanen, og katastroferne som du oplister tror jeg ikke kommer indenfor det næste halve år. Der skal være en smule realisme i det her.

- Vi vil stadig gerne være grønne og tage en masse initiativer. Det sker bare en lille smule senere. De få måneder fra eller til vil ikke være dem, der vælter vores omdømme i den store vide verden. Men det havde væltet vores energiø, hvis vi ikke får nogen indflydelse på, hvad der sker der. Derfor synes jeg, at pengene er prioriteret rigtigt, sagde Linda Kofoed Persson.


PLASTER PÅ SÅRET

Enhedslisten bad nu om en pause. Den tid brugte EL på at prøve at redde kommunens klimaplan og det videre arbejde med den.

Pengene var lige forsvundet, så til en start måtte de findes igen.

- På debatten kunne vi forstå, at ambitionerne i kommunalbestyrelsen er uformindskede på det grønne område. Derfor vil vi selvfølgelig gerne give kommunalbestyrelsen mulighed for at prioritere den uformindskede ambition ved, at vi tager pengene til punkt B i klimaplanen ved et kassetræk, sagde Morten Riis.

- Jeg bliver bare lidt forvirret, svarede René Danielsson (DF) og fortsatte: - .... i forhold til hele den her svada med ansvarlighed og hvorfor det var en dårlig idé at trække pengene op af kassen.

Men, men: Ligesom Socialdemokratiet netop havde afgjort at flytte penge fra klimaplanen til energiø-sekretariatet, havde S også de afgørende stemmer til at give Enhedslisten et plaster på såret.

Og sådan et fik Enhedslisten: Da S foreslog at finansiere klimaplanen året ud med 283.000 kroner fra kommunens kasse og de følgende år ind i uvisheden om det næste budget, stemte også Enhedslisten for det.

For Enhedslisten kunne ikke få det bedre.

Sådan gik det til, da alle fik noget. Og Socialdemokratiet klart fik markeret, hvem der deler ud, og hvem der også kan trække tæpperne væk under andre og inddrage penge igen.

Energiøen er en historisk stor milliardinvestering, der sker på Bornholm.

Det er sindssygt vigtigt, at vi som Bornholm, som bornholmere og som kommunalbestyrelse er med i det, der sker, og ikke bare er passive modtagere af noget, som nogle andre kommer og planter hos os Claus Larsen-Jensen Så meget for den grønne ø, hvis man følger den indstilling, der kommer fra René Danielsson - og så hult vil det klinge, når vi prøver at markedsføre os som en grøn ø Helle Munk Ravnborg.

Title: Parti sætter energiø til debat
Content:
Bornholm is the focal point when the Social Democracy invites you to a debate meeting at Bornholm's Efterskole. The party itself has proposed a comprehensive plan for the energy island, based on the idea that it will benefit Bornholm and the Bornholmers, according to a press release.

Group chairman Claus Larsen-Jensen will present the party's overall plan, director Søren Møller Christensen will talk about Baltic Energy Island, and parliamentary member Lea Wermelin will talk about what the government and the Folketing do. Then there is debate and the opportunity to ask questions.

The meeting takes place on April 13 in the evening.

Title: S ønsker power-to-x og erhvervspark ved landanlæg
Content:
A power-to-x plant and a green business park should be next to the energy island's land facility, says the Social Democracy. Large players are interested in shooting money, and Bornholm can only save welfare by seizing the possibility of growth, the former mayoral party has reached.

Next to the energy island's land plant at Sose, there must be a green business park and a power-to-x plant that can convert power into green fuel.

This is the opinion of the Social Democracy, which in the past month has marked itself as the most visibly driving force behind Bornholm getting the most out of the energy island.

The Social Democracy set out to propose a more offensive Bornholm line around the energy island. It was made concrete on Thursday when a majority in the municipal council decided to give the municipality a secretariat for the energy island and staff it with four employees.

Now the Social Democracy is following up by speaking for both business park and power-to-x next to the land facility where the power from the upcoming offshore wind turbines will be run ashore. Even if it will require to set off more area.

-The natural consequence is a power-to-x plant at the land plant. It is already for the reason that Ørsted and CIP's investment in an offshore wind farm number two will not come without Power-to-X, says group chairman Claus Larsen-Jensen (S).

- We are located right in the middle of the Baltic Sea, where 50,000 ships sail by a year. They need to use fuel. It's a little interesting, right? Due to the Energy Island and CIP and Ørsted's project and also by virtue of Bornholm's location, we are in a completely unique situation that we need to exploit, he says.

- It is logical that a green business park must be at the land plant, where all the energy will come in. The experience of the other places in Denmark also tells us that we have to place a business park at the land facility.

You should not spread things and have to transport the energy around, says Claus Larsen-Jensen.


The experiences of others convinced

Social democracy has been finally convinced of the energy island at the beginning of the year, when parts of the municipal council together with other Bornholm actors have been on study visits and seen large green plants in Esbjerg, Skive, Vordingborg, Aabenraa and Fredericia.

Therefore, S is now also taking steps to align expectations with the rest of Bornholm.

- It will be to cheat the Bornholmers if we take it on a case -by -case basis as each company approaches. It is more honest to say to people that the perspectives are these very large perspectives, but that we also have to have a fairly large area available once and for all to utilize the perspectives, says Claus Larsen-Jensen.

- I think we have to report to people on Bornholm that if we want to take advantage of the possibilities for cheap district heating and horticulture by virtue of the surplus heat and everything else it can become, then we must gather these activities one activities one place, namely at the land plant, and make the area bigger.

- It is also about securing the municipality a basis for revenue to do everything we want, but which we cannot today.

We just made a terrible budget and in the fall we're going to make a terrible budget more. We need to expand our opportunities by virtue of some new revenue, says Claus Larsen-Jensen.


S: New company should be at the forefront

The Social Democracy does not imagine that the municipality itself must buy land for a green commercial park, as Skive Municipality did 15 years ago. At least not as the most important actor.

Instead, the Social Democracy is up against Mayor Jacob Trøst (K), who, as the first, spoke to leave a development company to both buy land and develop the business park.

- I imagine that we start by deciding that we want a green business park.

And then we create a development company to take the investment in the area to be used and to create the opportunity and attract the companies, says Claus Larsen-Jensen.

- So land will have to be purchased next to the land plant. I do not know if the municipality should join it, but at least I do not imagine that it can stay on any large scale. After all, the municipality does not have the money to buy land for, he says.

However, both the money and the interest are found elsewhere, says Claus Larsen-Jensen.

- I'm pretty sure a number of pension companies would like to join. The pension companies are currently investing abroad because there are not enough projects in Denmark. We must not underestimate what it means that we are the first place in the world to get an energy island, he says.

- We go from being periphery to becoming part of the center, also in the Capital Region.

There will be massive interest, also from abroad.

The Social Democracy also believes that Bornholm has to make use of the interest in a green acquisition park at the land facility, which the party expects to find with strong forces.

- If we do not have pension funds or energy companies or anyone else of the size behind the Business Park's Development Cabin, we cannot be sure of having the raw strength that is needed to attract the companies we want, says Claus Larsen-Jensen .

It is also about securing the municipality an income base to do everything we want, but which we cannot today. We just made a terrible budget and in the fall we're going to make a terrible budget more. We need to expand our opportunities by virtue of some new revenue.

Claus Larsen-Jensen (S), group chairman.

Title: En grøn oprustning
Content:
The municipality will expand the number of employees dealing exclusively with the energy island from one to four. It is important that we work towards the Bornholm benefit from the green venture of the future.

What really is most important when we speak the energy island of the future? A better and greener world, where some of the major climate challenges are solved, must of course be and completely indisputably be ours' answer, but then we have to maintain here from Bornholm that just that - our beautiful, proud island - is an extremely important number two on the list. And on this basis, it is good that Bornholm Regional Municipality is now stirring from one to four employees who will have the energy island as their work area.

It is important that this huge state project is not something that comes from above and is pulled down over the head of the Bornholmers, but that we are involved and characterize the process as far as possible.

It is important that we look after nature, because it is to a great extent the one we live by. And of course we need to make sure that the neighbors of the upcoming land and other business changes that may be heading to South Bornholm are compensated.

In addition, of course, we must ensure good conditions for the companies that may want to come to Bornholm and join this adventure, as many say it is, and we must ensure that Bornholm gets the most out of the work, both in Connection with the construction phase and the subsequent operation, where there should be plenty of benefits to pick up. There is talk of cheap electricity and oceans of surplus heat, and the latter can be something that in the future can give us products and experiences that we are having a hard time today at all. We need to learn to understand, exploit and profit from it.

Keep in mind that we give a large area of ​​Bornholm to this project, so of course there must be something in it for us - beyond the enormous joy it will be if we can contribute to a better and more green future in this way .

It is important that this huge state project is not something that comes from above and is pulled down over the head of the Bornholmers.

Title: Hvad kan Bornholm udrette i samarbejde med Østersølandene?
Content:
Although it is almost impossible here and now to see a recovery of the good cooperation in the Baltic Sea, it must be in everyone's interest to get Russia and Kaliningrad again, and here Bornholm can play an important role.

30 years ago, Bornholm was one of the central actors in the development of cooperation in the Baltic Sea in the wake of the fall of the Berlin Wall and the end of the Cold War.

It was led by the then county mayor Knud Andersen, Deputy Mayor Elly Wolff and Mayor Annelise Molin - supplemented by active forces in both business and association life and well supported by both the EU and the Danish government.

With the war in Ukraine, the cooperation in the Baltic Sea has been weakened and again divided after Russia and Russian regions were suspended by various Baltic Sea organizations after the invasion last February. This applies, for example, to the collaboration on a better marine environment.

Can we use our experience from the 1990s in connection with the challenges cooperation in the Baltic Sea today is in - security policy, green transition and in other areas? How and when do we have Russia and Kaliningrad back in the collaboration? Does Bornholm have a role to play here? It will take many years. With the people of Ukraine as the most affected, we are all losers in the war that is now unfolding in Ukraine - even Russian President Putin.

Although it is almost impossible here and now to see a recovery of the good cooperation in the Baltic Sea, it must be in everyone's interest to get Russia and Kaliningrad again. It assumes that Russia will stop the war and withdraw from all occupied areas. Unfortunately, it has probably long prospects.

Thus, military units from Kaliningrad have been deployed in the Ukrainian Kherson region and leading officials from Kaliningrad have been deployed by the Russian aggressors in leading political positions in the Kherson region. It currently hinders the possibility of more formal contacts and cooperation with the authorities of the Kaliningrad region.

The experience of the 1990s obvious to use but when the situation had to justify it in the future, Bornholm can play an important role - just like in the 1990s, when Bornholm began his collaboration with Kaliningrad in 1995 and among other things. to retrain former Russian military people for agriculture and other professions.

The collaboration quickly evolved along more tracks :? Together with other Danish counties in Kaliningrad Friends Club, who regularly gathered at the Russian Embassy? Euroregion Baltic Collaboration from 1998, where Kaliningrad was a full member - the first Russian region of one of Europe's now about 180 euroregionale cooperation. ? Refleats collaboration between Kaliningrad, Bornholm and the Polish neighboring Region of Kaliningrad, Warmia-Mazury. This collaboration carried out more than 30 projects within a five -year period in agriculture, rural development, social and health field, media, culture, business promotion incl. Tourism etc.


It's about intercultural dialogue

The first and crucial phase of getting the Kaliningrad region back in the Baltic Society is to promote the intercultural dialogue - contacts in particular the association plan and between young people who can recreate understanding, attention and respect for our differences, cultural differences and different stands. It can then be followed up at the municipal and regional level. This was one of Bornholm's absolute top skills in the 1990s - and we may need it again. The collaboration here and now? The suspension of Russia and its regions such as Kaliningrad constitutes a weakening of the Baltic Sea cooperation, but does not mean that the cooperation has stopped - far from.

In some areas, the war in Ukraine has actually strengthened the collaboration, e.g. in green change and development of renewable energy - where it is about getting rid of the dependence on 'Putin's gas and oil'.

Bornholm remains active in the Baltic Society, although it is not comparable to the 1990s. The will for further commitment is present, this applies in the municipal council, in business and in the association life - but in particular the economy sets its boundaries for Bornholm's role and the extent of activities.

The Municipal Council's strategy for international cooperation, most recently revised in January 2021, has three focal points for the international activities: 1. can support the performance of the municipality's core tasks and the development at Bornholm 3. Project collaboration that supports the implementation of The municipal council's adopted strategies and action plans. We are good - and we can become better at the framework and conditions of cooperation in the Baltic Sea is for the most part together with EU policies and programs, including the EU's strategy for the Baltic Sea region.

Bornholm is well with, and for the past two years has picked up about 70 million. DKK from various EU programs to promote the green transition, work with Energiø Bornholm, waste management, wastewater projects, development of electricity structure, sustainable tourism and much more.

There are still opportunities that can be cultivated - and here we benefit greatly from, among other things, our Brussels Office (Greater Copenhagen EU Office), and the close cooperation on a daily basis with the many Bornholm players.

This applies in relation to the citizens and the association life, with initiatives such as Baltic Bridge and the youth cooperation both within the Euroregion Baltic and in four corner cooperation (Southeastern Skåne, Rügen, Swinoujscie and Bornholm).

This applies to business development with a focus on not least the green transition and the energy island. Here, there is a clear link to the EU's offshore energy strategy, to the Baltic Sea countries' common statements to promote offshore wind - and then to several of the EU programs that financially support this development, in some programs even with 100 percent financing.

And then it applies to all the other sectors and actors, e.g. Education, research and the entire welfare area, where there are new good opportunities in areas such as health, hospitals, elderly care and working with socially vulnerable citizens.


The debate

Where do we dream? Under that headline, Tidende puts together with Baltic Bridge, Lag-Bornholm, CRT and the Bornholm Citizens' Association's Collaboration in a number of debates.

The first is with the theme of Bornholm's role in the Baltic Sea and is about tension, conflicts, challenges and not least the possibilities of the future across the Baltic Sea.

Title: Konkurrencen stiger på havnen
Content:
We are busy for the next ten years, says Rønne Harbor, where the big shipping companies are moving in. BHS Shipping is aiming to create new collaborations with competitors.

Vestas, SDK and now also Blue Water are in place in Rønne Harbor.

SDK Shipping specializes in service for offshore projects, while Blue Water Shipping handles all types of call and service. Bluewater Shipping is thus a direct competitor to BHS Shipping, a subdivision of the large Bornholm freight company BHS Logistics.

However, Blue Water's presence at Rønne Harbor does not cause Mikkel Ørum from BH's Logistics to sleep at night.

- We have always known that they (the offshore wind turbines, ed.) Would attract other companies, including competitors.

Our attitude is that we collaborate and participate in what we can, says Mikkel Ørum, department director at BHS Logistics.

Currently, BHS is cooperating with Arcadia-cheese 1 site, and the experience from this shows that during the busiest periods, an extra 20-25 men are needed and partly in the office and partly at the harbor.


It's now they're coming

The hustle and bustle is felt elsewhere on the harbor.

Martin Ransted from Bornholm's electric motor is also experiencing increased activity at Sydhavnen.

- Now we've been walking around the hot porridge for seven years, but believe me, it's now that they're coming, he says.

- They want to join the energy island and all that is happening.

Martin Ransted has 30 years of experience as a service operator for drilling rigs as well as shipping and passenger ships, and therefore has many contacts in the industry. In addition, he is co -founder of the Offshore Center Bornholm, a network of Bornholm companies, which was founded nine years ago, just with the aim of being ready to service the major operators in the wind turbine fields in the Baltic Sea. He has held several meetings in recent weeks, hoping to establish cooperation with the new agents at Rønne Harbor. He has no doubt that the strategy has been right.

- We're getting busy for the next ten years, he says.

And it might be even longer than that. As a result of the climate crisis and most recently the war in Ukraine, more and more offshore wind projects are emerging in the Baltic Sea. At the same time, the three gigawatts of large energy island stands and flashes like the absolute largest pioneer project in the Baltic Sea. The energy island is scheduled to produce green power equivalent to 3.3 million household electricity consumption.

Mikkel Ørum from BHS Logistics guesses that the work on the energy island will really start in the late 2020s.

- My guess is after 2028. How busy we get until D, a depends on how many wind turbine projects are coming, how big they are and how close they are to each other, he says.

Title: Landanlæg nej tak: Ingen erstatning - ingen energiø
Content:
We have several times pointed out that there is a lack of legislation that can give neighbors to transformer systems, power-to-x plants, biogas plants and other energy industry, compensation for lost property value in the same way as for wind turbines and photovoltaic systems.

Then they did it anyway. The Folketing, Bornholm Regional Municipality and Energinet have presented the final location of the transformer station to Energiøen, and it is made completely regardless of the people who live in the area - ie the upcoming neighbors of the gigantic, industrial plant.

They could have placed the transformer station in the middle of the gross area with the greatest possible distance from the houses in the area and high lands around, but they have chosen to put the facility very close to the houses while the energy and authorities know that the legislation that can give the neighbors compensation , not in place.

Now the Happiness District is that the 'crack valley' down through the ugly transformer system must attract tourists who have to go for a walk along the dried -up Risebækken, which must also be transformed into a river larger than Læsåen. Then we must hope we do not remove the basis for the rest of Bornholm's tourist attractions.

Claus Larsen-Jensen is absolutely right that people must have a proper replacement. He writes that it is a pity that the legislation is not in place, but I will take it a step or two longer and say that it is a declaration of war against the neighbors that the legislation is not in place and it forces the neighbors to demonstrate And make actions against the land facility with a bad mention of Energiøen and Bornholm.

It is funny enough that if there is some legislation in the way of this project as protected coastal stretches or the law of coastal proximity, then these laws are removed as easily as nothing, where the authorities cooperate to grant exemptions and more.

The neighbors of the land plant - both transformer station and whatever else to be built by deadly industry in the area - have no rights whether we own the land or not.

The neighbors' legal certainty is not existing, and therefore they are now forced to break the law by making illegal demonstrations.

We have several times pointed out that there is a lack of legislation that can provide neighbors to transformer systems, power-to-x plants, biogas plants and other energy industry, compensation for lost property value in the same way as to wind turbines and photovoltaic systems, but the Folketing and Energinet And Bornholm's regional municipality turns both the blind eye and the deaf ear to us and continues the project because they expect we give up and soon shut up. We don't! I thought Denmark was a rule of law with just law, but we obviously live in a banana republic where the energy sector decides it all together with a power arrogant government that throws their taxpaying citizens under the bus at full speed.

Here I can again quote Egon Olsen: Our Lord is preserved! In Jutland, Energiø must also be made in the North Sea, and there they have fun enough found that they would rather have transformer station and power-to-x plants and more. Out on an island 80-100 kilometers from Jutland.

We, as taxpayers in Denmark, will probably also pay it on Bornholm.

Why can't we make an energy island out in the sea just like in Jutland? Is Bornholm less worthy than Jutland, or are our politicians not talented enough? There have been different figures on what the energy island in the North Sea will cost, but currently. one can read that the island itself will cost about DKK 10 billion - in addition, safely port and infrastructure before it can be compared to Bornholm, and it also costs many billions to establish.

But if we just say 10 billion on an island that needs a transformer station the size of ours on Bornholm for 3 GW plus a little area for breakwaters, then it is maybe 60 hectares.

It gives a price per hectares of approximately DKK 167 million compared to the land price of Bornholm of DKK 150,000. That is, the energy island in the North Sea costs over 1,100 times more per year. hectares.

When hopefully legislation will soon be made so that the neighbors at Bornholm get compensation, we may be talking about 50 properties around the plant, where they are close to the plant the most and those that are further away from the plant get less.

I do not know how much compensation it can make a total of, but I can guess at 50 million.

Thus, this corresponds to less than one third hectares on the energy island of the North Sea in order to be able to build the land plant on Bornholm without stealing the neighbors' property value.

I would once again encourage our politicians at Bornholm and in the Folketing to make the necessary legislation so that we can avoid this conflict further developing.

Try to put yourself in our place. How had you reacted if your house suddenly couldn't be sold and your savings were gone? Bornholm Regional Municipality should look at how Varde Municipality has succeeded in making a model for compensation for neighbors to wind turbines, and instead of saying there is a lack of legislation, Bornholm Regional Municipality should say to Energinet and the Folketing that the plans cannot be approved at Bornholm , before the legislation is in place to protect the neighbors.

Bornholmd Regional Municipality wants to be positive about the Engi Island, and they believe it is growing growth on Bornholm, but it should not be at the expense of the neighbors who are Bornholm citizens who pay taxes to Bornholm.

Title: Borgermøde om energiø: Trøst talte mulighederne op
Content:
After a long focus on the actual construction of the land facility, the mayor paid attention to the Citizens' Meeting on Thursday's attention to the growth potential, which in a broad sense follows with the energy island.

The impending changes of Bornholm interest the Bornholmers.

This can be concluded after Thursday's Citizens' Meeting on the Energy Island, which drew 225 participants to the Søndermarkshallen.

Originally, the Citizens' Meeting was planned to take place in Svanekehallen, but it was moved to Rønne to get more space. And it was, based on the attendance and the full rows of chairs in the Søndermarkshallen, a good decision, Jacob noted in his welcome.

He set out to highlight the value that part of the hall feels is under pressure due to the energy island.

- I moved to Bornholm three years ago, and I did this because of Bornholm's beautiful nature, says the former policeman, who was elected mayor in 2021.

He explains that he was hit by reality as he sat down in the mayor's chair, while on the screen behind him, he shows curves over the age distribution among the municipality's residents compared to the national average.

- We have high expenses and are too few to generate a tax base, he says, looking at the theme that has drawn people to the hall.

- I think the energy island will be the new resource. It is a huge opportunity for Bornholm. We must seize that chance if we are to lift Bornholm and our ability to manage ourselves - and not receive money from the pool to particularly difficult municipality.

The civic meeting has been staged by the municipality as the mayor's civic meeting.

After a strip of citizen meetings since 2021, which has had the giant construction of a high -voltage station at Sydbornholm as its focus, Thursday's event in Søndermarkshallen contained several dimensions.


Business Symbiosis

When the mayor talks about the energy island's possibilities, it is not just about the project Energiø Bornholm, ie the state -initiated project with wind farms south of Bornholm and an associated land plant in Sose for transforming and transforming the electricity.

- It's more wide. The meeting tonight is just held to talk about the perspectives, says Jacob Consolation to the Journal ahead of the meeting.

The energy opportunities also cover other offshore wind turbine projects that can carry local benefits in the form of surplus heat that can be utilized on a large scale to produce new professions such as horticulture and aquaculture, to dreams of research collaborations and the creation of educational places and the emergence of a business park that can become the focal point of the hopes of creating new, local jobs. The ports of Nexø and Rønne can be used as service ports, all the time the wind turbines must make electricity - or as a gas station (bunkerhub) for the ships passing by. In the construction phase of offshore wind farms and land facilities, hundreds of specialists will travel on Bornholm, and all will create a need for accommodation and residential construction, which is expected to put the local activity wheel in turns.

- We create a business symbiosis, Jacob states comfort.

He emphasizes that there is a prospect of energy companies and other companies that can benefit from electricity or heat will invest such large sums that it cannot avoid throwing anything for Bornholm.

- The common denominator is that we can create a growth through green transition. () If we succeed in this, Bornholm will become a showcase for what Bornholm can - and show that green transition, business development and nature restoration can actually go hand in hand, says Jacob Consolation in his welcome.

His assessment of the possibilities is shared by political colleagues.

- Energy Island is the largest public investment in Bornholm ever, said Linda Kofoed Persson (DF), which emphasized, among other things, the importance of keeping the steam up during the construction of new homes and thinking out of the box, so that permanent housing is established rather than Container cities for the traveling workers when wind turbines and high voltage systems are to be erected.

Most of the civic meeting took place after the editorial deadline. Read more about the energy island in Saturday newspaper.

Title: Naboer drog til borgermøde med følelsen af at være overhørt indtil nu
Content:
The residents near the upcoming high -voltage station at Sydbornholm flocked to Thursday's Citizens' Meeting, but unlike previous meetings, some of them drove home with the feeling that the organizers this time were more open and willing to tell openly about the energy plans.

"No thanks to Landslæg" says on an A4 sheet hanging on the door at the entrance to Søndermarkshallen. The paper is decorated with the red and green "together on Bornholm" logo, however, with the modification that a bite of South Bornholm has been taken. Inside the hall floor are some of the people living in "the missing piece of land".

Ten days have passed since Energinet published where in the designated gross area they request permission to build the land plant for the wind turbine project Energiø Bornholm. It was a message that the residents of Sose around Sdr. Road, Vasegårdsvej and Limensgaden had been waiting for. Previously, a course had gone with three citizen meetings and an architectural course with two workshops, which led up to the presentation last Monday in Nexø. Until now, the residents have not felt heard by the regional municipality and the state authorities. One of the reports that several of them use to justify the allegations is that the architects behind the course of citizen involvement invited young people to the workshop to Bornholm University and carried them in buses from Rønne in the afternoon before the event in the evening when the neighbors attended.

- When we got up there, many notes with ideas were set up, and then they (the organizers, ed.) Home and say they have used all our input. But it was not our input, says Lise Dandanell, chairman of the Citizens' Association Energiø Bornholm, which was founded a year ago by residents in the Sose area.

- It's pure symbolism, adds Jørn Sonne, who has to stop as a Christmas tree producer because his plantation is within the plan area.

- Twice workshops where you pick up people from Campus to write on some papers.

It's fake. It's gross abuse, he says.

So don't you count for real involvement of the local community? - No, it doesn't have a shit with it, says Jørn Sonne.

Is your point that the views of you living close by should have a greater weight? - Yes, and we don't have that, says Michael Jensen, who lives on Vasegårdsvej a few hundred meters from the nearest 25 meter high halls.

- Never. We drumed us, adds Lise Dandanell.


Missing rationale

Residents have struggled to get information about a power-to-X system, which has long been mentioned as a diffuse business opportunity without a specific place of attachment on a Bornholm map. The Danish Energy Agency, Energinet and the regional municipality have kept hydrogen production in a stretched arm, citing that the initiative must come from private companies, and CIP/ Ørsted, which plans for a huge wind turbine project east of Bornholm with associated electrolysis system has not announced where they prefer to Build.

Neighbors have also missed openness as to why the land plant should be located just in the fields north of Søndre Landevej and not another place. In consultation response, the municipality has received alternative proposals, which in the opinion of the South Bornholmers have never been assessed on a serious basis of Energinet.

- The whole problem lies in the fact that the location of this plant is designated by some lobbyists, and then the municipality has laid down. This is the fourth civic meeting, and we probably do not get a reason today for where you have chosen this area.

Now you choose a solution where you touch a good part of the neighbors and some farming, says Jørn Sonne, who is especially upset about how easily the state can be allowed to build a large energy plant in the open country, while his desire for wood planting In the same area, rejected blankly for the sake of the surroundings.

- If we had been asked in time, I think our peasants could have found some more suitable locations where there were some more trees and forests to cover, adds Jørn-Erik Kofoed, who owns 27 acres of land, which should expropriated if Energinet's proposal is realized.

Compensation and involvement As many others in the Sose area follows the farmer from St. Bakkegård joined in news of renewable energy, and it was envy that he recently heard about the procedure in Varde Municipality, where the setup of new wind turbines on land depended on the fact that most of the residents who live nearby accepted the project in advance.

- There was the mayor with the citizens.

When placing wind turbines on land, they put a dot on a map and designed a circle with a radius of six times the height of the wind turbines. 95 percent of citizens in that area should say yes - and they received compensation (50 percent of the property valuation, ed.). In the vast majority of cases, they were involved if they were compensated. Because they were involved and asked first - and we haven't been, says Jørn -Erik Kofoed.

It meets recognition from the Citizens' Association's chairman that the municipality seems to make an effort for the neighbors by making new demands on Energinet to start working on a local plan that the Journal wrote Friday. Until this week, the neighbors have not felt that the municipality was on their side.

- The municipality has followed Energinet's recommendations a hundred percent. It is only now that they say they will try to see if the local plan can be different. Otherwise, they have argued for Energinet's proposal, even though they have so many consultation responses lying down that point to everything else.

They are not used, says Lise Dandanell, before the Citizens' Meeting starts.


No question

As with a former citizen meeting in Aakirkebyhallen, the municipality had not set aside time on Thursday for questions in the plenary from the hall, and it aroused dissatisfaction from several participants who had been looking forward to asking questions or airing their dissatisfaction in everyone's hearing.

The presentations from the politicians on the podium are less about the land facility and the concerns and doubts that the neighbors have. On the other hand, there is a focus on visions, workplaces and green transition in the speeches, while Ringkøbing-Skjern Municipality's mayor, Hans Østergaard (V), gives a different perspective on the energy debate with the story of how the West Jews have handled the energy park Megaton, which will be putting in Brackets of 4,000 tonnes of agricultural land for solar cells, wind turbines and power-to-x plants.

Lise Dandanell believes that the Citizens' Meeting with the wider view on Thursday was the best in a row.

- I think it's fine that we got that knowledge from the mayors, she explains.

She feels it was easier to get tangible information out of the representatives than before, and highlights her talk with Baltic Energy Island's constituted director, Søren Møller Christensen, who gave a presentation on the fan of opportunities for the offshore wind turbine projects that the state and cip/ Ørsted Planning.

-I think they become clearer that Power-to-X is coming at the land facility. What we have always called for is that we can get a little on the sidelines, says Lise Dandanell.

Søren Møller Christensen offered to come out to give a presentation for the members of the Citizens' Association, whose chairman appreciates the openness that she has missed so far.

- Although one may feel that he serves the energy lobby's interests, it is good to be prepared for reality, she says of the head of Baltic Energy Island, a partnership with the participation of, among others, Ørsted, Energinet and Siemens-Gamesa.

It is not decided whether an electrolysis system should be placed clutched to the high voltage station, and in the end the municipal council has the final word. However, there are several logical benefits of this location that suggest that an energy park in the Sose area is the most likely outcome, says Søren Møller Christensen to the Journal. The same impression could be obtained from the signs in the municipality's exhibition: “A green energy park in connection with the energy island's high -voltage plants allows you to utilize the large quantities of wind turbine power of the future, allowing the large quantities of the future wind turbine power to produce green fuels such as hydrogen, ammonaik, biogas and Ethanol ”, it says.

If there is a business park with power-to-x and the follow-up industry next to the land plant, in Lise Dandanell's opinion, it will have an impact on the neighbors' claims, and therefore for some residents it may pay to wait for a better bid for a better bid for The extent of the energy plant and the real property value loss it entails. However, the closest neighbors of Energinet's high -voltage station will hardly be able to wait quite a while for a clarification, she notes.

Title: Mod vest kan energipenge gå til nye haller og forsamlingshuse - på Bornholm er gevinsten minimal
Content:
Huge energy project in Ringkøbing-Skjern Municipality will add at least DKK 270 million to the municipality because wind turbines and solar cells are established on land or near the coast. At Bornholm, the large offshore wind turbine projects do not give any money through the WE scheme, although the high voltage station and a possible power-to-X plant will seize large areas and strain nature.

The mayor of Ringkøbing-Skjern Municipality, Hans Østergaard (V), was invited to the Citizens' Meeting in Søndermarkshallen to talk about Project Megaton, which the municipality supports.

The name refers to the expectation that 1 million tonnes of green fuels be produced a year in the fields east of Tarm.

- Megaton is an investment in renewable energy of DKK 60 billion.

It is the biggest project we have ever been presented with. It will be one of the largest energy parks in Denmark, Europe, yes the world.

Megaton, which the company Greengo is behind, is an energy park with onshore wind turbines, solar cells and a power-to-x plant in Ringkøbing-Skjern Municipality as well as an offshore wind farm on 2 gigawatt off the coast. The different areas of solar cells and mills must be in the municipality, but not necessarily next to each other. The electrolysis system, where the power is to be used to make hydrogen, ammonia and methanol, must - as may be the case on Bornholm - placed in connection with a 400 Kilovolt -high voltage station, which is part of the backbone of the electricity grid along the west coast of Jutland, and one upcoming hydrogen pipeline in the same area.

When energy plants on that scale are on land, it contributes to the municipal treasury with three -digit million amounts, which Hans Østergaard highlights "can lay the foundation for local development and local projects".

- We are not blind to the project being able to add VE funds in a whole new order of magnitude to the local community and the municipality.

The statutory way alone - and it is only a small one of the total funds - is DKK 270 million. This is then built a couple of assembly houses and sports halls, said the mayor, who told the Bornholm Assembly that politicians are working to secure other benefits to the West Jews.

- Of course, we are working on solutions that can also ensure local ownership and anchoring in the project.


Only Bornholm's offshore wind is with

At Bornholm, the municipality's revenue through the WE schemes is far smaller, as offshore wind farms do not give any gain to the municipal treasury if they are not categorized as coastal, which means that they must stand a maximum of 15 kilometers from land.

Of the three offshore wind projects on the drawing board, the requirement is met only by Bornholm's offshore wind, which with a capacity of 100 megawatts and an estimated budget of 1.75 billion kroner to the park five-eight kilometers from Nexø and Snogebæk is the smallest of the smallest of The three.

Energiø Bornholm and CIP/ Ørsted's project further to the east do not contribute to the municipality's economy, and so does Energinet's high voltage station and a possible power-to-X plant either.

Of the other energy projects under planning, the solar cell park at Østerlars is covered by the RIGH rules, while the expansion of the biogas plant west of Aakirkeby is not. According to Helle Munk Ravnborg, who is involved in Bornholm's offshore wind's initiative group and as a person for the Nature, Environment and Committee, has insight into the other energy projects, the regional municipality can look forward to receiving DKK 16 million from the offshore wind turbine project and DKK 800,000 from the solar park, as European Park, Energy is behind.

- Just as you can say with the question of compensation to neighbors to the land plant, one can ask whether the RE scheme should be expanded to other branches of the green energy. It could also include the biogas plant or power-to-x, says Helle Munk Ravnborg to Journal.

While the municipalities' economic yields are very different, there are several similarities between the huge energy projects at each end of the country.

Like Bornholm, Hans Østergaard hopes that surplus heat from the Power-to-X plant in the Megaton project will benefit residents in the immediate area-this means that many citizens will potentially access a green and priced heat supply-with one Powerful price reduction, said Hans Østergaard, who also drawn attention to a few of the major dilemmas of the project.

- Taking 4000 hectares of agricultural land out of service is not for fun. Sometimes the agendas clash with each other.

Here it is about the need to make a green transition, but at the same time there is also a lack of food, so it is a difficult role to stand in. To reach the goal of our climate plan, some agricultural land must already be taken out of operation, and I hope we can make it smart, so that the place where the agricultural land is taken out of operation will be where we plant the solar cells.

The West Jutland project has many things in common with the local dreams prior to the establishment of the offshore wind farms and the high-voltage connections, which will make Bornholm an electric hub between the Baltic Sea countries.

- We expect the project to provide both settlement and employment to the area of ​​the municipality, says Ringkøbing-Skjern mayor and elaborates:- We are talking about jobs to installers and engineers, hotels and restaurants and throughout the followers. In addition to the construction phase itself, it is estimated that there will be approximately 300 permanent jobs in connection with the energy park.

- In addition, the business opportunities that are expected to arise in the wake of the project. For some professions, synergies can occur by placing themselves in the immediate association with an energy park.

Title: Flot redningsforsøg på Energiø
Content:
The Nature Environment and Planning Committee has together taken a good initiative to save the poor neighbors to the land facility. Energinet should avoid a war with Bornholm on the energy island. It loses everyone.

How good is our municipal politicians' latest joint initiative to save the relatively few homeowners who will get serious nuisance from the planned land plant to the energy island.

Unfortunately, it is a well -known case that Energinet's plans for the large land plant for the energy island will hit the relatively few close neighbors in Sydbornholm.

They have all bought or inherited houses that, according to the energy island's plans, will fall significantly in value. Their bricks have become significantly less worthwhile when three million household electricity consumption rushes past 100 meters from their dining rooms in 25 meters high buildings.

Had the same homeowners lived next to a solar cell park or an investment park, they would have been given the compensation.

But because the plans for energy islands are brand new, the legislation does not yet allow Energinet to compensate the affected neighbors or buy their land when they really do not need them for the construction.

That problem has explained both neighbors and politicians here in the Journal. But it takes time for Christiansborg to correct the law. Meanwhile, you sleep really bad at Sydbornholm.

For most of us, the owner -occupied home is the greatest investment of our lives. When the state wants to establish a large energy industry on the neighboring land, it is more than understandable that the night's sleep is being challenged. So far so good.

Today's good announcement is now that the municipality, with the politicians at the forefront, has set out to remedy the Folketing's Smobling.

Fortunately, not by paying the affected citizens with the few kroner of the municipal fund. But by pushing Energinet to expand the local plan area of ​​the project.

The municipality decides on the local plans, and if the affected neighbors are initially included in the local plan, it is the municipality's assessment that Energinet can and must buy the buildings legally. However, so far, Energinet has not had that interpretation.

But it is super strong that Bornholm fights for its citizens and exploits the central position that the municipality has as a partner and local planner.

Energinet can choose to run the hard line and drum Bornholm's regional municipality with a country plan directive. But it will certainly be a bad idea for the popular support for the green project to declare war with their local democracy.

For all parties, it is important to solve the problems for the close neighbors as soon as possible, so that the focus can instead come on green development of Bornholm. It is a waste of green billions that the important night's sleep of the homeowners is allowed to be the biggest point of the debate.

Title: Bekymrede naboer i første række: Når man ikke ved noget som helst, bliver det et pres
Content:
The best possible scenario for Michael and Pia Jensen on Vasegårdsvej is that the legislation is changed so that they have the opportunity to get rid of their house before the construction of the high -voltage station starts around their homes.

Energinet's decision on the location of the land facility has for the residents and farmers in the area turned upside down on the thoughts of their future. For those who own land within the area itself, an expropriation case awaits where the value of properties, fields and plantations must be calculated. For the neighbors who live outside the 107 -hectare local plan area, which Energinet has requested Bornholm Regional Municipality to start from, the uncertainty about the future is at least as great, for they are with the existing legislation not guaranteed compensation.

Michael and Pia Jensen live on the corner of Vasegårdsvej and Sdr. Road, and their garden borders up to the local plan area.

- We are very affected. They talk about Vasegårdsvej being expanded, and there is heavy traffic throughout the construction phase, ie right up and down our kitchen window. It will be a tough time, says Michael Jensen, who met the Journal at the Citizens' Meeting on the energy potential on Thursday.

Did you prefer to be within the local plan area? - Yes, clearly, says Michael Jensen, who expects the family to be better in terms of being able to get a replacement.

- We get very close. They talk about being 250 meters to the first building. And when you don't know anything about noise or anything, it becomes a pressure - and that's how it is already.

What is for you to see the best imaginable scenario? - It would be to be bought out instead of having a house lying next to such a road. I would prefer, because it will not be fun, says Michael Jensen, who has lived in the house for 17 years and had never imagined that it would be built on the open spaces in the backyard.

A few days before Energinet presented their project proposals to all of Bornholm, Michael and Pia Jensen met with an employee.

- We have had a visit from Energinet, but he couldn't show much more than it has all seen. We only know what came up at the meeting in Nexø, says Michael Jensen.

On the opposite side of the building field, on the west side of the Limensgaden, lives Dorthea Bartos.

She gets almost 200 meters to the fence, and some of the nearest installations become Master, which belongs to the transformer station.

She shares the critical view of the involvement process that many neighbors have.

- We have no voice, she says.

What is the most important goal for you now? - I think we all agree that the most important thing is that nature is taken more seriously, says Lise Dandanell from Pærgård and chairman of the Citizens' Association Energiø Bornholm.

- We live in some nature and they will destroy nature that they cannot restore.

Whether we live close to the land facility or slightly, we need to say, "Have you thought about what you do about nature?" - The Baltic Sea Pearl is no longer, adds Dorthea Bartos, who particularly cares about wildlife.

- We have such a lovely scenery right there. We have nightingale, bats, various frogs and farm hens, of which there are not many. I think it is a crime against Bornholm and against nature. We should not be energy island, she says categorically.

Michael and Pia Jensen from Vasegårdsvej stand next door and listen.

Many at citizen meetings talk about the growth opportunities and the new industries that can arise on Bornholm as a result of the energy adventure.

It probably feels less relevant when you live so close? - No, that's right, replies Michael Jensen affirming.

For those of you who live in the first row, is it the sake of nature or the question of getting a proper compensation that fills the most? - Of course we would like to live in the area.

It is a nice place and we have lovely sea views.

The problem is that we do not know the scenarios of that plant. After all, our whole nature on that corner will be gone. We can't help but look that way and look out at the sea.

But if we get a highway up past the kitchen window, then it won't be fun. If we are to stay, I would clearly think that we need an amount. And it must all all the way around that facility because it will be a deterioration, says Michael Jensen, who doubts that the properties will regain value after the construction period.

- It may well be that someone says that in five to six years people will get used to it, and then the value is up to the old level, but I do not believe that. For the building is still 25 meters high and you never get some trees up to that height, says Michael Jensen.

The municipality proposes to require Energinet to change the local plan area for the sake of the neighbors and their opportunity for compensation. In a response to the municipality, Energinet has announced that the law does not make it possible to expropriate properties due to landscape adaptation aimed at mitigating effects when establishing the station.

"Therefore, the areas of landing/ expropriation of landing of landscape measures can not be freely acquired/ expropriated. Energinet previously wrote in the municipality in response to the regional municipality.

The neighbors of the land facility can expect relatively peace and quiet for a few more years. The actual construction work will be initiated at the earliest in 2025, as Energinet will first have to obtain permits to build the station and the plant.

    Michael and Pia Jensen have recently begun to doubt the future in their homes through 17 years on the corner of Vasegårdsvej and Søndre Landevej. They are among the closest neighbors of the upcoming high -voltage station, and although the nearest building will simply stand 250 meters away, and the driveway to the construction field is led close to the house, the couple with the current rules is not entitled to any compensation.
